transliteration: Nín huì jīngcháng chī zhǐtòngyào ma, bǐrú bùluòfēn?
translation: 您会经常吃止痛药吗，比如布洛芬？

english: Do you have any medication allergies?
transliteration: Nín duì shénme yàowù guòmǐn ma?
translation: 您对什么药物过敏吗？

english: Are you completely unable to pass urine?
transliteration: Nín wánquán niào bu chūlái ma?
translation: 您完全尿不出来吗？

english: Do you have severe pain in a testicle that began suddenly?
transliteration: Nín de gāowán shì bu shì tūrán kāishǐ jùliè téngtòng?
translation: 您的睾丸是不是突然开始剧烈疼痛？

english: Do you have fever with severe back or side pain?
transliteration: Nín fāshāo shí, bèibù huò cèyāo huì jùliè téngtòng ma?
translation: 您发烧时，背部或侧腰会剧烈疼痛吗？

english: Are you passing large blood clots in your urine?
transliteration: Nín niào lǐ yǒu dà kuài xuèkuài ma?
translation: 您尿里有大块血块吗？

english: Are you feeling faint, confused, or very unwell?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu juéde kuài yào yūndǎo, yìshí bù qīng, huòzhě fēicháng bù shūfu?
translation: 您有没有觉得快要晕倒、意识不清，或者非常不舒服？

english: Have you had new weakness or numbness in your legs?
transliteration: Nín de tuǐ zuìjìn yǒu méiyǒu wúlì huò mámù?
translation: 您的腿最近有没有无力或麻木？

english: Have you lost feeling around your groin or private parts?
transliteration: Nín de fùgǔgōu huò sīchù zhōuwéi yǒu méiyǒu shīqù zhījué?
translation: 您的腹股沟或私处周围有没有失去知觉？

english: Have you suddenly lost control of your bladder or bowels?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu tūrán wúfǎ kòngzhì dàxiǎobiàn?
translation: 您有没有突然无法控制大小便？

english: Have you been vomiting and unable to keep fluids down?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu yìzhí ǒutù, hē xiàqu de yètǐ yě liú bu zhù?
translation: 您有没有一直呕吐，喝下去的液体也留不住？

english: Please lie down on your back.
transliteration: Qǐng yǎngwò tǎng xià.
translation: 请仰卧躺下。

english: I will examine your abdomen and lower back.
transliteration: Wǒ huì jiǎnchá nín de fùbù hé xià bèibù.
translation: 我会检查您的腹部和下背部。

english: Please point to the area that hurts.
transliteration: Qǐng zhǐchū téngtòng de dìfang.
translation: 请指出疼痛的地方。

english: I will press gently on your lower abdomen.
transliteration: Wǒ huì qīngqīng ànyā nín de xià fùbù.
translation: 我会轻轻按压您的下腹部。

english: Tell me if it hurts when I press here.
transliteration: Wǒ àn zhèlǐ shí, rúguǒ nín juéde téng, qǐng gàosu wǒ.
translation: 我按这里时，如果您觉得疼，请告诉我。

english: I am going to tap gently on your back near the kidneys.
transliteration: Wǒ huì zài nín kàojìn shènzàng de bèibù qīngqīng kòu jǐ xià.
translation: 我会在您靠近肾脏的背部轻轻叩几下。

english: I may need to examine your genital area; I will explain and ask permission first.
transliteration: Wǒ kěnéng xūyào jiǎnchá nín de shēngzhíqì bùwèi. Wǒ huì xiān xiàng nín jiěshì bìng zhēngqiú nín de tóngyì.
translation: 我可能需要检查您的生殖器部位。我会先向您解释并征求您的同意。

english: Please tell me immediately if anything hurts.
transliteration: Rúguǒ yǒu rènhé dìfang téng, qǐng mǎshàng gàosu wǒ.
translation: 如果有任何地方疼，请马上告诉我。

english: We can pause or stop the examination at any time.
transliteration: Jiǎnchá guòchéng zhōng, nín suíshí kěyǐ yāoqiú zàntíng huò tíngzhǐ.
translation: 检查过程中，您随时可以要求暂停或停止。

english: A prostate examination may be helpful; I will explain it first.
transliteration: Jiǎnchá qiánlièxiàn kěnéng huì yǒu bāngzhù, wǒ huì xiān xiàng nín jiěshì.
translation: 检查前列腺可能会有帮助，我会先向您解释。

english: The prostate examination may involve a gloved finger in the rectum.
transliteration: Qiánlièxiàn jiǎnchá kěnéng xūyào dài shǒutào de shǒuzhǐ shēn rù zhícháng.
translation: 前列腺检查可能需要戴手套的手指伸入直肠。

english: Is it okay to proceed with this examination?
transliteration: Nín tóngyì wǒmen jìnxíng zhè xiàng jiǎnchá ma?
translation: 您同意我们进行这项检查吗？

english: Would you like a chaperone for this examination?
transliteration: Nín xīwàng yǒu rén péitóng nín zuò zhè xiàng jiǎnchá ma?
translation: 您希望有人陪同您做这项检查吗？

english: Please turn onto your side.
transliteration: Qǐng cèshēn tǎng.
translation: 请侧身躺。

english: Please bend your knees toward your chest.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ xīgài wān qǐlái, kàojìn xiōngkǒu.
translation: 请把膝盖弯起来，靠近胸口。

english: I will check for swelling or tenderness in the scrotum.
transliteration: Wǒ huì jiǎnchá nín de yīnnáng yǒu méiyǒu zhǒngzhàng huò yātòng.
translation: 我会检查您的阴囊有没有肿胀或压痛。

english: Please cough while I examine your groin.
transliteration: Wǒ jiǎnchá nín fùgǔgōu shí, qǐng késou yíxià.
translation: 我检查您腹股沟时，请咳嗽一下。

english: We need a urine sample.
transliteration: Wǒmen xūyào yí fèn niàoyè yàngběn.
translation: 我们需要一份尿液样本。

english: Please collect urine in this clean container.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ niàoyè shōují zài zhège gānjìng de róngqì lǐ.
translation: 请把尿液收集在这个干净的容器里。

english: We will test your urine for infection and blood.
transliteration: Wǒmen huì jiǎnchá nín de niàoyè, kàn yǒu méiyǒu gǎnrǎn hé xuè.
translation: 我们会检查您的尿液，看有没有感染和血。

english: We may send the urine for a culture.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng huì bǎ niàoyè sòng qù zuò péiyǎng jiǎnchá.
translation: 我们可能会把尿液送去做培养检查。

english: We would like to check your kidney function with blood tests.
transliteration: Wǒmen xiǎng tōngguò yànxuè jiǎnchá nín de shèn gōngnéng.
translation: 我们想通过验血检查您的肾功能。

english: We may arrange an ultrasound of your kidneys and bladder.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng huì ānpái nín zuò shènzàng hé pángguāng chāoshēng jiǎnchá.
translation: 我们可能会安排您做肾脏和膀胱超声检查。

english: We may need a CT scan to look for kidney stones.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng xūyào gěi nín zuò CT sǎomiáo, jiǎnchá yǒu méiyǒu shèn jiéshí.
translation: 我们可能需要给您做CT扫描，检查有没有肾结石。

english: We may check how much urine remains in your bladder after you urinate.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng huì jiǎnchá nín páiniào hòu pángguāng lǐ hái shèng duōshao niào.
translation: 我们可能会检查您排尿后膀胱里还剩多少尿。

english: We may need a camera examination of the bladder called cystoscopy.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng xūyào yòng pángguāngjìng jiǎnchá pángguāng.
translation: 我们可能需要用膀胱镜检查膀胱。

english: We may need to give you antibiotics.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng xūyào gěi nín yòng kàngshēngsù.
translation: 我们可能需要给您用抗生素。

english: Please take this medicine exactly as prescribed.
transliteration: Qǐng yángé ànzhào chǔfāng fúyòng zhè zhǒng yào.
translation: 请严格按照处方服用这种药。

english: You may need a catheter to drain your bladder.
transliteration: Nín kěnéng xūyào yòng dǎoniàoguǎn yǐnliú pángguāng lǐ de niàoyè.
translation: 您可能需要用导尿管引流膀胱里的尿液。

english: We will explain the catheter procedure and ask for your consent.
transliteration: Wǒmen huì xiàng nín jiěshì dǎoniàoguǎn cāozuò, bìng zhēngqiú nín de tóngyì.
translation: 我们会向您解释导尿管操作，并征求您的同意。

english: Please keep the catheter bag below the level of your bladder.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ dǎoniàodài fàng zài dī yú pángguāng de wèizhi.
translation: 请把导尿袋放在低于膀胱的位置。

english: You may need to strain your urine to collect a stone.
transliteration: Nín kěnéng xūyào yòng lǜwǎng guòlǜ niàoyè, shōují jiéshí.
translation: 您可能需要用滤网过滤尿液，收集结石。

english: We may refer you to a urologist.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng huì zhuǎnzhěn nín qù kàn mìniàokē yīshēng.
translation: 我们可能会转诊您去看泌尿科医生。

english: We may refer you to a kidney specialist.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng huì zhuǎnzhěn nín qù kàn shènzàng zhuānkē yīshēng.
translation: 我们可能会转诊您去看肾脏专科医生。

english: If you cannot urinate or develop severe pain or fever, seek urgent care.
transliteration: Rúguǒ nín wúfǎ páiniào, huò chūxiàn jùliè téngtòng huò fāshāo, qǐng lìjí jiùyī.
translation: 如果您无法排尿，或出现剧烈疼痛或发烧，请立即就医。

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: Nín yǒu shénme wèntí ma?
translation: 您有什么问题吗？

english: Can you tell me which symptoms would need urgent medical attention?
transliteration: Nín néng gàosu wǒ, chūxiàn nǎxiē zhèngzhuàng shí xūyào jǐnjí jiùyī ma?
translation: 您能告诉我，出现哪些症状时需要紧急就医吗？

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: Wǒmen huì wèi nín ānpái fùzhěn.
translation: 我们会为您安排复诊。

english: Please return if your symptoms worsen.
transliteration: Rúguǒ nín de zhèngzhuàng jiāzhòng, qǐng huílái jiùzhěn.
translation: 如果您的症状加重，请回来就诊。

english: Thank you for speaking with me today.
transliteration: Xièxie nín jīntiān hé wǒ jiāoliú.
translation: 谢谢您今天和我交流。

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: Nín jīntiān wèishénme lái kànbìng?
translation: 您今天为什么来看病？

english: When did your symptoms start?
transliteration: Nín de zhèngzhuàng shì shénme shíhou kāishǐ de?
translation: 您的症状是什么时候开始的？

english: Have your symptoms been getting worse?
transliteration: Nín de zhèngzhuàng zuìjìn jiāzhòng le ma?
translation: 您的症状最近加重了吗？

english: Do you have any other symptoms?
transliteration: Nín hái yǒu qítā zhèngzhuàng ma?
translation: 您还有其他症状吗？

english: May I ask about your medical history?
transliteration: Wǒ kěyǐ wèn yíxià nín de bìngshǐ ma?
translation: 我可以问一下您的病史吗？

english: May I examine you?
transliteration: Wǒ kěyǐ gěi nín zuò jiǎnchá ma?
translation: 我可以给您做检查吗？

english: Would you like an interpreter?
transliteration: Nín xūyào kǒuyìyuán ma?
translation: 您需要口译员吗？

english: Have you been diagnosed with diabetes?
transliteration: Yīshēng zhěnduàn guo nín huàn yǒu tángniàobìng ma?
translation: 医生诊断过您患有糖尿病吗？

english: Do you have type 1 or type 2 diabetes?
transliteration: Nín huàn de shì yī xíng háishi èr xíng tángniàobìng?
translation: 您患的是1型还是2型糖尿病？

english: How long have you had diabetes?
transliteration: Nín huàn tángniàobìng duōjiǔ le?
translation: 您患糖尿病多久了？

english: Are you more thirsty than usual?
transliteration: Nín bǐ píngshí gèng róngyì kǒukě ma?
translation: 您比平时更容易口渴吗？

english: Are you urinating more often?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn xiǎobiàn cìshù gèng duō le ma?
translation: 您最近小便次数更多了吗？

english: Do you wake up at night to urinate?
transliteration: Nín wǎnshang huì qǐchuáng xiǎobiàn ma?
translation: 您晚上会起床小便吗？

english: Have you lost weight without trying?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu zài méiyǒu kèyì jiǎnféi de qíngkuàng xià tǐzhòng xiàjiàng?
translation: 您有没有在没有刻意减肥的情况下体重下降？

english: Do you feel more hungry than usual?
transliteration: Nín bǐ píngshí gèng róngyì juéde è ma?
translation: 您比平时更容易觉得饿吗？

english: Have you noticed blurred vision?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu fāxiàn shìlì móhu?
translation: 您有没有发现视力模糊？

english: Do you feel unusually tired?
transliteration: Nín juéde tèbié píjuàn ma?
translation: 您觉得特别疲倦吗？

english: Have you had frequent infections?
transliteration: Nín jīngcháng gǎnrǎn ma?
translation: 您经常感染吗？

english: Do your wounds take a long time to heal?
transliteration: Nín de shāngkǒu shì bu shì hěn jiǔ cái yùhé?
translation: 您的伤口是不是很久才愈合？

english: Do you check your blood sugar at home?
transliteration: Nín zài jiā cè xuètáng ma?
translation: 您在家测血糖吗？

english: How often do you check your blood sugar?
transliteration: Nín duōjiǔ cè yí cì xuètáng?
translation: 您多久测一次血糖？

english: What was your last blood sugar reading?
transliteration: Nín shàng cì cè de xuètáng shì duōshao?
translation: 您上次测的血糖是多少？

english: Do you use a continuous glucose monitor?
transliteration: Nín shǐyòng liánxù xuètáng jiāncèyí ma?
translation: 您使用连续血糖监测仪吗？

english: Have you brought your glucose readings?
transliteration: Nín dàilái xuètáng jìlù le ma?
translation: 您带来血糖记录了吗？

english: Have you had an HbA1c blood test?
transliteration: Nín zuò guo tánghuà xuèhóngdànbái (HbA1c) xuèyè jiǎnchá ma?
translation: 您做过糖化血红蛋白（HbA1c）血液检查吗？

english: We will check your blood sugar now.
transliteration: Wǒmen xiànzài gěi nín cè yíxià xuètáng.
translation: 我们现在给您测一下血糖。

english: Your blood sugar is higher than the target.
transliteration: Nín de xuètáng bǐ mùbiāo zhí gāo.
translation: 您的血糖比目标值高。

english: Have you ever had low blood sugar?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián yǒu guo dī xuètáng ma?
translation: 您以前有过低血糖吗？

english: Do you get shaky or sweaty when your sugar is low?
transliteration: Nín xuètáng dī shí huì juéde fādǒu huò chūhàn ma?
translation: 您血糖低时会觉得发抖或出汗吗？

english: Do you feel dizzy or confused when your sugar is low?
transliteration: Nín xuètáng dī shí huì juéde tóuyūn huò yìshí bù qīng ma?
translation: 您血糖低时会觉得头晕或意识不清吗？

english: Have you ever fainted because of low blood sugar?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu yīnwèi dī xuètáng yūndǎo guo?
translation: 您有没有因为低血糖晕倒过？

english: What do you do when your blood sugar is low?
transliteration: Xuètáng dī de shíhou, nín huì zěnme zuò?
translation: 血糖低的时候，您会怎么做？

english: Do you carry something sugary with you?
transliteration: Nín huì suíshēn dài yìxiē hántáng de dōngxi ma?
translation: 您会随身带一些含糖的东西吗？

english: Have you had very high blood sugar recently?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn yǒu guò xuètáng tèbié gāo de qíngkuàng ma?
translation: 您最近有过血糖特别高的情况吗？

english: Have you had nausea, vomiting, or stomach pain?
transliteration: Nín yǒu ěxīn, ǒutù huò wèitòng ma?
translation: 您有恶心、呕吐或胃痛吗？

english: Are you breathing faster or deeper than usual?
transliteration: Nín hūxī de bǐ píngshí gèng kuài huò gèng shēn ma?
translation: 您呼吸得比平时更快或更深吗？

english: Have you ever been hospitalized for diabetic ketoacidosis?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián yīn tángniàobìng tóngzhèng suān zhòngdú zhù guò yuàn ma?
translation: 您以前因糖尿病酮症酸中毒住过院吗？

english: What medicines do you take for diabetes?
transliteration: Nín chī shénme yào zhìliáo tángniàobìng?
translation: 您吃什么药治疗糖尿病？

english: Do you take diabetes tablets?
transliteration: Nín chī zhìliáo tángniàobìng de yàopiàn ma?
translation: 您吃治疗糖尿病的药片吗？

english: Do you use insulin?
transliteration: Nín shǐyòng yídǎosù ma?
translation: 您使用胰岛素吗？

english: How many units of insulin do you take?
transliteration: Nín měi cì yòng duōshao dānwèi de yídǎosù?
translation: 您每次用多少单位的胰岛素？

english: When do you take your insulin?
transliteration: Nín shénme shíhou yòng yídǎosù?
translation: 您什么时候用胰岛素？

english: Did you take your insulin today?
transliteration: Nín jīntiān yòng yídǎosù le ma?
translation: 您今天用胰岛素了吗？

english: Have you missed any doses recently?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn lòu yòng guò yào ma?
translation: 您最近漏用过药吗？

english: Do you use an insulin pen or pump?
transliteration: Nín yòng yídǎosù bǐ háishi yídǎosù bèng?
translation: 您用胰岛素笔还是胰岛素泵？

english: Where do you inject your insulin?
transliteration: Nín bǎ yídǎosù zhùshè zài nǎlǐ?
translation: 您把胰岛素注射在哪里？

english: Do you rotate your injection sites?
transliteration: Nín huì lúnhuàn zhùshè bùwèi ma?
translation: 您会轮换注射部位吗？

english: Have you had side effects from your medicines?
transliteration: Nín de yào yǐqǐ guò fùzuòyòng ma?
translation: 您的药引起过副作用吗？

english: Would you like me to show you how to inject insulin?
transliteration: Nín xiǎng ràng wǒ jiāo nín zěnme zhùshè yídǎosù ma?
translation: 您想让我教您怎么注射胰岛素吗？

english: Do you have numbness or tingling in your feet?
transliteration: Nín de jiǎo yǒu mámù huò cìtòng de gǎnjué ma?
translation: 您的脚有麻木或刺痛的感觉吗？

english: Do you have burning pain in your feet?
transliteration: Nín de jiǎo yǒu zhuótòng gǎn ma?
translation: 您的脚有灼痛感吗？

english: Have you noticed any sores on your feet?
transliteration: Nín zhùyì dào jiǎo shàng yǒu shāngkǒu ma?
translation: 您注意到脚上有伤口吗？

english: Do you check your feet every day?
transliteration: Nín měitiān jiǎnchá zìjǐ de jiǎo ma?
translation: 您每天检查自己的脚吗？

english: Have you had a diabetic eye examination?
transliteration: Nín zuò guò tángniàobìng yǎndǐ jiǎnchá ma?
translation: 您做过糖尿病眼底检查吗？

english: Has diabetes affected your kidneys?
transliteration: Tángniàobìng yǐngxiǎng dào nín de shènzàng le ma?
translation: 糖尿病影响到您的肾脏了吗？

english: Have you had a heart attack or stroke?
transliteration: Nín dé guò xīnzàngbìng huò zhòngfēng ma?
translation: 您得过心脏病或中风吗？

english: I am going to check the feeling in your feet.
transliteration: Wǒ xiànzài yào jiǎnchá nín jiǎo shàng de gǎnjué.
translation: 我现在要检查您脚上的感觉。

english: Can you feel this on your toes?
transliteration: Nín néng gǎnjué dào wǒ pèng nín de jiǎozhǐ ma?
translation: 您能感觉到我碰您的脚趾吗？

english: Have you ever had a thyroid problem?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián yǒu guò jiǎzhuàngxiàn wèntí ma?
translation: 您以前有过甲状腺问题吗？

english: Do you have an underactive thyroid?
transliteration: Nín de jiǎzhuàngxiàn gōngnéng jiǎntuì ma?
translation: 您的甲状腺功能减退吗？

english: Do you have an overactive thyroid?
transliteration: Nín de jiǎzhuàngxiàn gōngnéng kàngjìn ma?
translation: 您的甲状腺功能亢进吗？

english: Do you feel unusually cold?
transliteration: Nín juéde yìcháng pàlěng ma?
translation: 您觉得异常怕冷吗？

english: Do you feel unusually hot or sweaty?
transliteration: Nín juéde yìcháng rè huò chūhàn hěn duō ma?
translation: 您觉得异常热或出汗很多吗？

english: Have you noticed your heart racing?
transliteration: Nín zhùyì dào zìjǐ de xīntiào hěn kuài ma?
translation: 您注意到自己的心跳很快吗？

english: Have you noticed shaking in your hands?
transliteration: Nín zhùyì dào zìjǐ de shǒu zài fādǒu ma?
translation: 您注意到自己的手在发抖吗？

english: Have you been constipated?
transliteration: Nín yǒu biànmì ma?
translation: 您有便秘吗？

english: Have you been having frequent bowel movements?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn dàbiàn cìshù hěn duō ma?
translation: 您最近大便次数很多吗？

english: Have you noticed swelling in your neck?
transliteration: Nín zhùyì dào bózi zhǒng qǐlái le ma?
translation: 您注意到脖子肿起来了吗？

english: Is it difficult to swallow?
transliteration: Nín tūnyàn kùnnán ma?
translation: 您吞咽困难吗？

english: Has your voice become hoarse?
transliteration: Nín de shēngyīn biàn de sīyǎ le ma?
translation: 您的声音变得嘶哑了吗？

english: Do you take thyroid medication?
transliteration: Nín fúyòng jiǎzhuàngxiàn yàowù ma?
translation: 您服用甲状腺药物吗？

english: Have you had thyroid surgery or radioactive iodine treatment?
transliteration: Nín zuò guò jiǎzhuàngxiàn shǒushù huò fàngshèxìng diǎn zhìliáo ma?
translation: 您做过甲状腺手术或放射性碘治疗吗？

english: Has your weight changed recently?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn tǐzhòng yǒu biànhuà ma?
translation: 您最近体重有变化吗？

english: How much weight have you gained or lost?
transliteration: Nín tǐzhòng zēngjiā huò jiǎnshǎo le duōshao?
translation: 您体重增加或减少了多少？

english: Has your appetite changed?
transliteration: Nín de shíyù yǒu biànhuà ma?
translation: 您的食欲有变化吗？

english: What do you usually eat in a day?
transliteration: Nín píngshí yì tiān dōu chī xiē shénme?
translation: 您平时一天都吃些什么？

english: How often do you exercise?
transliteration: Nín duōjiǔ duànliàn yí cì?
translation: 您多久锻炼一次？

english: Do you drink sugary drinks?
transliteration: Nín hē hántáng yǐnliào ma?
translation: 您喝含糖饮料吗？

english: Have you tried making changes to your diet?
transliteration: Nín shì guò gǎibiàn yǐnshí xíguàn ma?
translation: 您试过改变饮食习惯吗？

english: Would you like help with weight management?
transliteration: Nín xiǎng yào huòdé tǐzhòng guǎnlǐ fāngmiàn de bāngzhù ma?
translation: 您想要获得体重管理方面的帮助吗？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you ever broken a bone after a minor fall?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu qīngqīng shuāidǎo hòu shuāiduàn guò gǔtou?
translation: 您有没有轻轻摔倒后摔断过骨头？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you been told you have osteoporosis?
transliteration: Yǒu rén gàosu guò nín huàn yǒu gǔzhì shūsōng zhèng ma?
translation: 有人告诉过您患有骨质疏松症吗？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you had a bone density scan?
transliteration: Nín zuò guò gǔ mìdù sǎomiáo ma?
translation: 您做过骨密度扫描吗？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Do you take calcium or vitamin D?
transliteration: Nín fúyòng gàipiàn huò wéishēngsù D ma?
translation: 您服用钙片或维生素D吗？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you had kidney stones?
transliteration: Nín dé guò shènjiéshí ma?
translation: 您得过肾结石吗？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Do you have muscle cramps or spasms?
transliteration: Nín yǒu jīròu jìngluán huò chōuchù ma?
translation: 您有肌肉痉挛或抽搐吗？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Do you have tingling around your mouth or fingers?
transliteration: Nín de zuǐ zhōuwéi huò shǒuzhǐ yǒu cìtòng gǎn ma?
translation: 您的嘴周围或手指有刺痛感吗？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you been diagnosed with a parathyroid problem?
transliteration: Nín bèi zhěnduàn chū yǒu jiǎzhuàng pángxiàn wèntí ma?
translation: 您被诊断出有甲状旁腺问题吗？

english: Have you ever had a problem with your adrenal glands?
transliteration: Nín de shènshàngxiàn yǐqián chū guò wèntí ma?
translation: 您的肾上腺以前出过问题吗？

english: Do you take steroid medicines such as prednisone?
transliteration: Nín fúyòng pōní sōng děng lèigùchún yàowù ma?
translation: 您服用泼尼松等类固醇药物吗？

english: How long have you been taking steroids?
transliteration: Nín fúyòng lèigùchún yàowù duōjiǔ le?
translation: 您服用类固醇药物多久了？

english: Have you recently stopped taking steroids?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn tíngyòng lèigùchún yàowù le ma?
translation: 您最近停用类固醇药物了吗？

english: Do you feel dizzy when you stand up?
transliteration: Nín zhàn qǐlái shí huì tóuyūn ma?
translation: 您站起来时会头晕吗？

english: Have you noticed darker patches of skin?
transliteration: Nín zhùyì dào pífū shàng yǒu yánsè jiào shēn de bānkuài ma?
translation: 您注意到皮肤上有颜色较深的斑块吗？

english: Do you crave salty foods?
transliteration: Nín tèbié xiǎng chī xián de shíwù ma?
translation: 您特别想吃咸的食物吗？

english: Have you noticed easy bruising or purple stretch marks?
transliteration: Nín zhùyì dào zìjǐ róngyì yūqīng huò yǒu zǐsè de rènshēnwén ma?
translation: 您注意到自己容易淤青或有紫色的妊娠纹吗？

english: Do you have an emergency steroid plan?
transliteration: Nín yǒu jǐnjí qíngkuàng xià shǐyòng lèigùchún de jìhuà ma?
translation: 您有紧急情况下使用类固醇的计划吗？

english: Have you had persistent headaches or changes in vision?
transliteration: Nín yǒu chíxù tóutòng huò shìlì biànhuà ma?
translation: 您有持续头痛或视力变化吗？

english: Have your periods become irregular or stopped?
transliteration: Nín de yuèjīng biàn de bù guīlǜ huò tíng le ma?
translation: 您的月经变得不规律或停了吗？

english: Have you noticed unexpected milk discharge from your breasts?
transliteration: Nín zhùyì dào rǔfáng yǒu yìwài yìrǔ ma?
translation: 您注意到乳房有意外溢乳吗？

english: Have you noticed changes in sexual desire?
transliteration: Nín zhùyì dào xìngyù yǒu biànhuà ma?
translation: 您注意到性欲有变化吗？

english: Have you had problems with erections?
transliteration: Nín bóqǐ yǒu kùnnán ma?
translation: 您勃起有困难吗？

english: Have you noticed increased facial or body hair?
transliteration: Nín zhùyì dào liǎn shàng huò shēnshang de máofà biàn duō le ma?
translation: 您注意到脸上或身上的毛发变多了吗？

english: Have you noticed unusual acne or hair loss?
transliteration: Nín zhùyì dào cuóchuāng yìcháng huò diào fà le ma?
translation: 您注意到痤疮异常或掉发了吗？

english: Have you had difficulty becoming pregnant?
transliteration: Nín huáiyùn yǒu kùnnán ma?
translation: 您怀孕有困难吗？

english: Are you taking any hormone treatment?
transliteration: Nín zhèngzài jiēshòu jīsù zhìliáo ma?
translation: 您正在接受激素治疗吗？

english: Does anyone in your family have diabetes?
transliteration: Nín de jiārén zhōng yǒu rén huàn yǒu tángniàobìng ma?
translation: 您的家人中有人患有糖尿病吗？

english: Does anyone in your family have thyroid disease?
transliteration: Nín de jiārén zhōng yǒu rén huàn yǒu jiǎzhuàngxiàn jíbìng ma?
translation: 您的家人中有人患有甲状腺疾病吗？

english: Do you have high blood pressure or high cholesterol?
transliteration: Nín yǒu gāoxuèyā huò gāo dǎngùchún ma?
translation: 您有高血压或高胆固醇吗？

english: Do you have any kidney or heart problems?
transliteration: Nín de shènzàng huò xīnzàng yǒu wèntí ma?
translation: 您的肾脏或心脏有问题吗？

english: Have you had any surgery?
transliteration: Nín zuò guò shǒushù ma?
translation: 您做过手术吗？

english: Are you pregnant or planning a pregnancy?
transliteration: Nín xiànzài huáiyùn le huò jìhuà huáiyùn ma?
translation: 您现在怀孕了或计划怀孕吗？

english: Do you smoke or drink alcohol?
transliteration: Nín xīyān huò hējiǔ ma?
translation: 您吸烟或喝酒吗？

english: Do you have any medication allergies?
transliteration: Nín duì shénme yàowù guòmǐn ma?
translation: 您对什么药物过敏吗？

english: I am going to measure your height and weight.
transliteration: Wǒ xiànzài yào liáng yíxià nín de shēngāo hé tǐzhòng.
translation: 我现在要量一下您的身高和体重。

english: I am going to check your blood pressure.
transliteration: Wǒ xiànzài yào liáng yíxià nín de xuèyā.
translation: 我现在要量一下您的血压。

english: Please hold your hands out in front of you.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ shuāngshǒu shēn dào nín miànqián.
translation: 请把双手伸到您面前。

english: I am checking whether your hands are shaking.
transliteration: Wǒ zhèngzài jiǎnchá nín de shǒu shìfǒu fādǒu.
translation: 我正在检查您的手是否发抖。

english: Please tilt your head back slightly.
transliteration: Qǐng shāowēi bǎ tóu xiàng hòu yǎng.
translation: 请稍微把头向后仰。

english: Please swallow while I examine your neck.
transliteration: Wǒ jiǎnchá nín bózi shí, qǐng tūnyàn yíxià.
translation: 我检查您脖子时，请吞咽一下。

english: I am going to feel your thyroid gland.
transliteration: Wǒ xiànzài yào mō yíxià nín de jiǎzhuàngxiàn.
translation: 我现在要摸一下您的甲状腺。

english: Please follow my finger with your eyes.
transliteration: Qǐng yòng yǎnjing gēnzhe wǒ de shǒuzhǐ kàn.
translation: 请用眼睛跟着我的手指看。

english: I am going to examine your feet for sores.
transliteration: Wǒ xiànzài yào jiǎnchá nín de jiǎo shàng yǒu méiyǒu shāngkǒu.
translation: 我现在要检查您的脚上有没有伤口。

english: Please tell me when you feel this touch.
transliteration: Nín gǎnjué dào wǒ pèng nín shí, qǐng gàosu wǒ.
translation: 您感觉到我碰您时，请告诉我。

english: I am going to check your reflexes.
transliteration: Wǒ xiànzài yào jiǎnchá nín de fǎnshè.
translation: 我现在要检查您的反射。

english: We need a blood test to check your thyroid hormones.
transliteration: Wǒmen xūyào yànxuè, jiǎnchá nín de jiǎzhuàngxiàn jīsù.
translation: 我们需要验血，检查您的甲状腺激素。

english: We will check your HbA1c to assess your average blood sugar.
transliteration: Wǒmen huì jiǎnchá nín de HbA1c, pínggū nín de píngjūn xuètáng shuǐpíng.
translation: 我们会检查您的 HbA1c，评估您的平均血糖水平。

english: We need to check your kidney function.
transliteration: Wǒmen xūyào jiǎnchá nín de shèn gōngnéng.
translation: 我们需要检查您的肾功能。

english: We will check your cholesterol.
transliteration: Wǒmen huì jiǎnchá nín de dǎngùchún.
translation: 我们会检查您的胆固醇。

english: We need a urine sample.
transliteration: Wǒmen xūyào yí fèn niàoyè yàngběn.
translation: 我们需要一份尿液样本。

english: You may need an ultrasound of your thyroid.
transliteration: Nín kěnéng xūyào zuò jiǎzhuàngxiàn chāoshēng jiǎnchá.
translation: 您可能需要做甲状腺超声检查。

english: We may need a bone density scan.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng xūyào zuò gǔ mìdù jiǎnchá.
translation: 我们可能需要做骨密度检查。

english: Please follow the fasting instructions for this test.
transliteration: Qǐng ànzhào zhè xiàng jiǎnchá de jìnshí yāoqiú jìnxíng.
translation: 请按照这项检查的禁食要求进行。

english: We will review your medications together.
transliteration: Wǒmen huì yìqǐ chákàn nín zhèngzài shǐyòng de yàowù.
translation: 我们会一起查看您正在使用的药物。

english: Please take this medicine as prescribed.
transliteration: Qǐng ànzhào chǔfāng fúyòng zhè zhǒng yào.
translation: 请按照处方服用这种药。

english: Do not change your insulin dose without guidance.
transliteration: Wèijīng zhǐdǎo, qǐng búyào gēnggǎi yídǎosù jìliàng.
translation: 未经指导，请不要更改胰岛素剂量。

english: Do not stop long-term steroids suddenly without medical advice.
transliteration: Wèijīng yīshēng jiànyì, qǐng búyào tūrán tíngyòng chángqī fúyòng de lèigùchún yàowù.
translation: 未经医生建议，请不要突然停用长期服用的类固醇药物。

english: We can arrange a visit with a diabetes educator.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěyǐ ānpái nín yǔ tángniàobìng jiàoyùshī jiànmiàn.
translation: 我们可以安排您与糖尿病教育师见面。

english: Please bring your medicines and glucose readings next time.
transliteration: Xià cì qǐng dài shàng nín de yàowù hé xuètáng dúshù.
translation: 下次请带上您的药物和血糖读数。

english: We will discuss a plan that works for you.
transliteration: Wǒmen huì tǎolùn yí ge shìhé nín de jìhuà.
translation: 我们会讨论一个适合您的计划。

english: Are you very drowsy or confused?
transliteration: Nín shìfǒu kùnjuàn de lìhai, huòzhě gǎndào kùnhuò?
translation: 您是否困倦得厉害，或者感到困惑？

english: Are you vomiting and unable to keep fluids down?
transliteration: Nín shìfǒu yìzhí zài ǒutù, lián shuǐ yě hē bu xiàqù?
translation: 您是否一直在呕吐，连水也喝不下去？

english: Do you have severe weakness or fainting?
transliteration: Nín shìfǒu gǎndào fēicháng xūruò, huòzhě yūndǎo guo?
translation: 您是否感到非常虚弱，或者晕倒过？

english: Seek urgent medical help if you become confused or faint.
transliteration: Rúguǒ nín biànde shénzhì bù qīng huò yūndǎo, qǐng lìjí xúnqiú yīliáo bāngzhù.
translation: 如果您变得神志不清或晕倒，请立即寻求医疗帮助。

english: When is your next follow-up appointment?
transliteration: Nín xià cì fùzhěn shì shénme shíhou?
translation: 您下次复诊是什么时候？

english: Do you have any questions about the plan?
transliteration: Nín duì zhège jìhuà yǒu shénme yíwèn ma?
translation: 您对这个计划有什么疑问吗？

english: What would you like help with today?
transliteration: Jīntiān nín xīwàng wǒmen bāng nín jiějué shénme wèntí?
translation: 今天您希望我们帮您解决什么问题？

english: How have you been feeling lately?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn gǎnjué zěnmeyàng?
translation: 您最近感觉怎么样？

english: Is it okay if I ask some personal questions?
transliteration: Wǒ kěyǐ wèn nín yìxiē gèrén wèntí ma?
translation: 我可以问您一些个人问题吗？

english: You can tell me if a question feels uncomfortable.
transliteration: Rúguǒ yǒuxiē wèntí ràng nín juéde bù shūfu, nín kěyǐ gàosu wǒ.
translation: 如果有些问题让您觉得不舒服，您可以告诉我。

english: I will listen without judging you.
transliteration: Wǒ huì rènzhēn qīngtīng, bú huì píngpàn nín.
translation: 我会认真倾听，不会评判您。

english: Would you prefer to speak with an interpreter?
transliteration: Nín yuànyì hé kǒuyìyuán jiāotán ma?
translation: 您愿意和口译员交谈吗？

english: I will explain the limits of confidentiality.
transliteration: Wǒ huì xiàng nín jiěshì bǎomì de fànwéi hé xiànzhì.
translation: 我会向您解释保密的范围和限制。

english: Is there anything important you want me to know?
transliteration: Yǒu shénme zhòngyào de shìqing shì nín xīwàng wǒ liǎojiě de ma?
translation: 有什么重要的事情是您希望我了解的吗？

english: When did these feelings or symptoms begin?
transliteration: Zhèxiē gǎnshòu huò zhèngzhuàng shì shénme shíhou kāishǐ de?
translation: 这些感受或症状是什么时候开始的？

english: Did anything happen around the time they started?
transliteration: Zhèxiē qíngkuàng kāishǐ shí, qiánhòu fāshēng guo shénme shì ma?
translation: 这些情况开始时，前后发生过什么事吗？

english: Have things been getting better or worse?
transliteration: Qíngkuàng yǒu hǎozhuǎn háishi biàn zāo le?
translation: 情况有好转还是变糟了？

english: How often do you feel this way?
transliteration: Nín duōjiǔ huì yǒu zhè zhǒng gǎnjué?
translation: 您多久会有这种感觉？

english: How much is this affecting your daily life?
transliteration: Zhè duì nín de rìcháng shēnghuó yǐngxiǎng yǒu duō dà?
translation: 这对您的日常生活影响有多大？

english: Are you able to go to work or school?
transliteration: Nín hái néng qù shàngbān huò shàngxué ma?
translation: 您还能去上班或上学吗？

english: Are you managing your usual responsibilities?
transliteration: Nín hái néng chǔlǐ píngshí yào zuò de shìqing ma?
translation: 您还能处理平时要做的事情吗？

english: What has helped you cope so far?
transliteration: Dào mùqián wéizhǐ, shénme bāngzhù nín yìngduì zhèxiē qíngkuàng?
translation: 到目前为止，什么帮助您应对这些情况？

english: Have you been feeling sad or down?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn shìfǒu gǎndào bēishāng huò qíngxù dīluò?
translation: 您最近是否感到悲伤或情绪低落？

english: Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
transliteration: Nín duì yǐqián xǐhuan zuò de shìqing shīqù xìngqù le ma?
translation: 您对以前喜欢做的事情失去兴趣了吗？

english: Do you feel hopeless about the future?
transliteration: Nín duì wèilái gǎndào juéwàng ma?
translation: 您对未来感到绝望吗？

english: Do you feel guilty or worthless?
transliteration: Nín shìfǒu juéde nèijiù huò juéde zìjǐ yì wú shì chù?
translation: 您是否觉得内疚或觉得自己一无是处？

english: Do you cry more often than usual?
transliteration: Nín kū de bǐ píngshí gèng pínfán ma?
translation: 您哭得比平时更频繁吗？

english: Has your energy been low?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn shìfǒu gǎndào jīnglì bùzú?
translation: 您最近是否感到精力不足？

english: Is it hard to concentrate or make decisions?
transliteration: Nín shìfǒu hěn nán jízhōng zhùyìlì huò zuò juédìng?
translation: 您是否很难集中注意力或做决定？

english: Have you noticed changes in your appetite?
transliteration: Nín zhùyì dào shíyù yǒu biànhuà ma?
translation: 您注意到食欲有变化吗？

english: Have you noticed any changes in your weight?
transliteration: Nín zhùyì dào tǐzhòng yǒu biànhuà ma?
translation: 您注意到体重有变化吗？

english: Do you often feel worried or anxious?
transliteration: Nín shìfǒu jīngcháng gǎndào dānxīn huò jiāolǜ?
translation: 您是否经常感到担心或焦虑？

english: Is it difficult to control your worries?
transliteration: Nín shìfǒu hěn nán kòngzhì zìjǐ de dānyōu?
translation: 您是否很难控制自己的担忧？

english: Do you feel restless or on edge?
transliteration: Nín shìfǒu gǎndào zuòlì bù'ān huò jǐnzhāng?
translation: 您是否感到坐立不安或紧张？

english: Do you have sudden episodes of intense fear?
transliteration: Nín shìfǒu huì tūrán gǎndào jídù hàipà?
translation: 您是否会突然感到极度害怕？

english: During these episodes, does your heart race?
transliteration: Fāzuò shí, nín de xīntiào huì jiākuài ma?
translation: 发作时，您的心跳会加快吗？

english: Do you feel short of breath when anxious?
transliteration: Nín jiāolǜ shí huì gǎndào hūxī jícù ma?
translation: 您焦虑时会感到呼吸急促吗？

english: Do you avoid places because you fear having a panic attack?
transliteration: Nín huì yīnwèi hàipà kǒnghuāng fāzuò ér bìkāi mǒuxiē dìfang ma?
translation: 您会因为害怕恐慌发作而避开某些地方吗？

english: Do unwanted thoughts keep coming into your mind?
transliteration: Nín nǎohǎi lǐ huì búduàn chūxiàn bù xiǎng yào de xiǎngfǎ ma?
translation: 您脑海里会不断出现不想要的想法吗？

english: Do you feel you must repeat certain actions?
transliteration: Nín juéde zìjǐ bìxū chóngfù zuò mǒuxiē shìqing ma?
translation: 您觉得自己必须重复做某些事情吗？

english: How many hours do you sleep each night?
transliteration: Nín měi wǎn shuì jǐ ge xiǎoshí?
translation: 您每晚睡几个小时？

english: Is it difficult to fall asleep?
transliteration: Nín shìfǒu hěn nán rùshuì?
translation: 您是否很难入睡？

english: Do you wake up often during the night?
transliteration: Nín yèlǐ jīngcháng xǐnglái ma?
translation: 您夜里经常醒来吗？

english: Do you wake up earlier than you want to?
transliteration: Nín shìfǒu huì bǐ zìjǐ xiǎng yào de shíjiān gèng zǎo xǐnglái?
translation: 您是否会比自己想要的时间更早醒来？

english: Do you feel rested in the morning?
transliteration: Nín zǎoshang xǐnglái shí juéde xiūxi gòu le ma?
translation: 您早上醒来时觉得休息够了吗？

english: Do you have nightmares?
transliteration: Nín zuò èmèng ma?
translation: 您做噩梦吗？

english: Have you been sleeping much more than usual?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn shìfǒu bǐ píngshí shuì de duō hěn duō?
translation: 您最近是否比平时睡得多很多？

english: Do you feel tired during the day?
transliteration: Nín báitiān huì gǎndào píjuàn ma?
translation: 您白天会感到疲倦吗？

english: Have there been times when you felt unusually energetic or excited?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu guo jīnglì huò xīngfèn chéngdù yìcháng gāo de shíhou?
translation: 您有没有过精力或兴奋程度异常高的时候？

english: Have you needed much less sleep without feeling tired?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu guo shuì de shǎo hěn duō què bù juéde lèi de shíhou?
translation: 您有没有过睡得少很多却不觉得累的时候？

english: Have others said you were talking unusually fast?
transliteration: Yǒu rén shuō guo nín shuōhuà sùdù yìcháng kuài ma?
translation: 有人说过您说话速度异常快吗？

english: Have your thoughts been racing?
transliteration: Nín shìfǒu juéde sīxù fēikuài?
translation: 您是否觉得思绪飞快？

english: Have you felt unusually confident or powerful?
transliteration: Nín shìfǒu gǎndào zìjǐ yìcháng zìxìn huò qiángdà?
translation: 您是否感到自己异常自信或强大？

english: Have you spent more money than you intended?
transliteration: Nín huā de qián yǒu méiyǒu chāoguò yuánběn dǎsuàn de shùmù?
translation: 您花的钱有没有超过原本打算的数目？

english: Have you taken unusual risks during these periods?
transliteration: Zài zhèxiē shíqī, nín yǒu méiyǒu mào guo píngshí bú huì mào de fēngxiǎn?
translation: 在这些时期，您有没有冒过平时不会冒的风险？

english: How long did these periods last?
transliteration: Zhèxiē shíqī chíxù le duōjiǔ?
translation: 这些时期持续了多久？

english: Have you heard voices that others cannot hear?
transliteration: Nín tīngdào guo biérén tīng bú dào de shēngyīn ma?
translation: 您听到过别人听不到的声音吗？

english: Have you seen things that others cannot see?
transliteration: Nín kàndào guo biérén kàn bú dào de dōngxi ma?
translation: 您看到过别人看不到的东西吗？

english: Do you feel that someone is watching or following you?
transliteration: Nín juéde yǒu rén zài jiānshì huò gēnzōng nín ma?
translation: 您觉得有人在监视或跟踪您吗？

english: Do you feel that someone wants to harm you?
transliteration: Nín juéde yǒu rén xiǎng shānghài nín ma?
translation: 您觉得有人想伤害您吗？

english: Do you feel your thoughts are being controlled?
transliteration: Nín juéde zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ shòudào kòngzhì ma?
translation: 您觉得自己的想法受到控制吗？

english: Do the voices ever tell you to do something?
transliteration: Nàxiē shēngyīn yǒu méiyǒu jiào nín qù zuò shénme?
translation: 那些声音有没有叫您去做什么？

english: What do you think these experiences mean?
transliteration: Nín juéde zhèxiē jīnglì yìwèizhe shénme?
translation: 您觉得这些经历意味着什么？

english: Do these experiences frighten you?
transliteration: Zhèxiē jīnglì huì ràng nín hàipà ma?
translation: 这些经历会让您害怕吗？

english: Sometimes when people feel overwhelmed, they think about death. Has that happened to you?
transliteration: Yǒushí, rénmen gǎndào nányǐ chéngshòu shí huì xiǎngdào sǐwáng. Nín yǒu guo zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng ma?
translation: 有时，人们感到难以承受时会想到死亡。您有过这种情况吗？

english: Have you wished you could go to sleep and not wake up?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu xīwàng zìjǐ shuìzháo hòu zài yě búyào xǐnglái?
translation: 您有没有希望自己睡着后再也不要醒来？

english: Have you had thoughts of ending your life?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu xiǎng guo jiéshù zìjǐ de shēngmìng?
translation: 您有没有想过结束自己的生命？

english: Are you having those thoughts right now?
transliteration: Nín xiànzài yǒu zhèxiē xiǎngfǎ ma?
translation: 您现在有这些想法吗？

english: Have you thought about how you might do it?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu xiǎng guo kěnéng huì zěnme zuò?
translation: 您有没有想过可能会怎么做？

english: Have you made a plan to end your life?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu zhìdìng jiéshù zìjǐ shēngmìng de jìhuà?
translation: 您有没有制定结束自己生命的计划？

english: Do you have access to anything you might use to hurt yourself?
transliteration: Nín shìfǒu néng nádào rènhé kěnéng yòng lái shānghài zìjǐ de dōngxi?
translation: 您是否能拿到任何可能用来伤害自己的东西？

english: Have you ever tried to end your life before?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián yǒu méiyǒu shìtú jiéshù zìjǐ de shēngmìng?
translation: 您以前有没有试图结束自己的生命？

english: Have you ever hurt yourself on purpose?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu gùyì shānghài guo zìjǐ?
translation: 您有没有故意伤害过自己？

english: What has helped you stay safe so far?
transliteration: Dào mùqián wéizhǐ, shénme bāngzhù nín bǎochí ānquán?
translation: 到目前为止，什么帮助您保持安全？

english: Is there someone you trust whom we can contact?
transliteration: Yǒu méiyǒu nín xìnrèn, wǒmen kěyǐ liánxì de rén?
translation: 有没有您信任、我们可以联系的人？

english: I am concerned about your safety and want to help you stay safe.
transliteration: Wǒ dānxīn nín de ānquán, yě xiǎng bāngzhù nín quèbǎo ānquán.
translation: 我担心您的安全，也想帮助您确保安全。

english: Do you feel safe where you live?
transliteration: Nín zài zhù de dìfang juéde ānquán ma?
translation: 您在住的地方觉得安全吗？

english: Has anyone threatened or hurt you?
transliteration: Yǒu rén wēixié guo nín huò shānghài guo nín ma?
translation: 有人威胁过您或伤害过您吗？

english: Are you afraid of anyone at home?
transliteration: Nín hàipà jiālǐ de mǒu ge rén ma?
translation: 您害怕家里的某个人吗？

english: Have you had thoughts of hurting someone else?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu xiǎng guo shānghài biérén?
translation: 您有没有想过伤害别人？

english: Is there a particular person you are thinking about hurting?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu tèbié xiǎng shānghài mǒu ge rén?
translation: 您有没有特别想伤害某个人？

english: Do you have a plan to hurt anyone?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu shānghài biérén de jìhuà?
translation: 您有没有伤害别人的计划？

english: Are there children or other vulnerable people at home?
transliteration: Jiālǐ yǒu háizi huò qítā xūyào tèbié bǎohù de rén ma?
translation: 家里有孩子或其他需要特别保护的人吗？

english: Have you experienced something frightening or traumatic?
transliteration: Nín jīnglì guo ràng nín hàipà huò zàochéng chuāngshāng de shìqing ma?
translation: 您经历过让您害怕或造成创伤的事情吗？

english: You do not have to share details before you are ready.
transliteration: Nín kěyǐ děng zhǔnbèi hǎo le zài fēnxiǎng xìjié.
translation: 您可以等准备好了再分享细节。

english: Do memories of that experience come back unexpectedly?
transliteration: Nà duàn jīnglì de jìyì huì bú huì chūhū yìliào de fúxiàn chūlái?
translation: 那段经历的记忆会不会出乎意料地浮现出来？

english: Do you have nightmares about what happened?
transliteration: Nín huì mèngdào fāshēng guo de shìqing ma?
translation: 您会梦到发生过的事情吗？

english: Do you avoid reminders of what happened?
transliteration: Nín huì bìkāi ràng nín xiǎngqǐ nà jiàn shì de rén huò shìwù ma?
translation: 您会避开让您想起那件事的人或事物吗？

english: Do you feel constantly on guard or unsafe?
transliteration: Nín shìfǒu zǒng juéde xūyào bǎochí jǐngtì, huòzhě gǎndào bù ānquán?
translation: 您是否总觉得需要保持警惕，或者感到不安全？

english: Do you sometimes feel disconnected from yourself or your surroundings?
transliteration: Nín yǒushí huì juéde zìjǐ yǔ zìjǐ huò zhōuwéi huánjìng tuōjié ma?
translation: 您有时会觉得自己与自己或周围环境脱节吗？

english: Do you drink alcohol?
transliteration: Nín hējiǔ ma?
translation: 您喝酒吗？

english: How often and how much do you drink?
transliteration: Nín duōjiǔ hē yí cì jiǔ? Měi cì hē duōshǎo?
translation: 您多久喝一次酒？每次喝多少？

english: Have you wanted to cut down on drinking?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu xiǎngguo shǎo hē diǎn jiǔ?
translation: 您有没有想过少喝点酒？

english: Has anyone expressed concern about your drinking?
transliteration: Yǒu rén dānxīn guo nín hējiǔ de qíngkuàng ma?
translation: 有人担心过您喝酒的情况吗？

english: Do you use cannabis?
transliteration: Nín shǐyòng dàmá ma?
translation: 您使用大麻吗？

english: Do you use cocaine, opioids, or other drugs?
transliteration: Nín shǐyòng kěkǎyīn, āpiànlèi yàowù huò qítā dúpǐn ma?
translation: 您使用可卡因、阿片类药物或其他毒品吗？

english: Have you ever injected drugs?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián zhùshè guo dúpǐn ma?
translation: 您以前注射过毒品吗？

english: When did you last use alcohol or other substances?
transliteration: Nín shàng cì hējiǔ huò shǐyòng qítā wùzhì shì shénme shíhou?
translation: 您上次喝酒或使用其他物质是什么时候？

english: Do you feel shaky or unwell when you stop using them?
transliteration: Tíngzhǐ shǐyòng zhèxiē wùzhì shí, nín huì juéde fādǒu huò bù shūfu ma?
translation: 停止使用这些物质时，您会觉得发抖或不舒服吗？

english: Have you ever had a seizure during withdrawal?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián zài jièduàn shí fāzuò guo diānxián ma?
translation: 您以前在戒断时发作过癫痫吗？

english: Would you like support to reduce or stop using substances?
transliteration: Nín xiǎng huòdé bāngzhù, jiǎnshǎo huò tíngzhǐ shǐyòng zhèxiē wùzhì ma?
translation: 您想获得帮助，减少或停止使用这些物质吗？

english: How do you feel about your eating habits?
transliteration: Nín zěnme kàn zìjǐ de yǐnshí xíguàn?
translation: 您怎么看自己的饮食习惯？

english: Do you worry a lot about your weight or body shape?
transliteration: Nín chángcháng dānxīn zìjǐ de tǐzhòng huò shēncái ma?
translation: 您常常担心自己的体重或身材吗？

english: Have you been skipping meals or restricting food?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn yǒu bù chīfàn huò xiànzhì jìnshí ma?
translation: 您最近有不吃饭或限制进食吗？

english: Do you sometimes feel unable to stop eating?
transliteration: Nín yǒushí huì juéde zìjǐ kòngzhì bu zhù de chī dōngxi ma?
translation: 您有时会觉得自己控制不住地吃东西吗？

english: Have you made yourself vomit after eating?
transliteration: Nín chī wán dōngxi hòu, yǒu guo zìjǐ cuītù de qíngkuàng ma?
translation: 您吃完东西后，有过自己催吐的情况吗？

english: Have you been exercising to compensate for eating?
transliteration: Nín huì tōngguò duànliàn lái míbǔ chī dōngxi ma?
translation: 您会通过锻炼来弥补吃东西吗？

english: Have you had trouble paying attention?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn yǒu zhùyìlì bù jízhōng de qíngkuàng ma?
translation: 您最近有注意力不集中的情况吗？

english: Do you often forget appointments or tasks?
transliteration: Nín jīngcháng wàngjì yuēzhěn huò yào zuò de shìqing ma?
translation: 您经常忘记约诊或要做的事情吗？

english: Have you noticed changes in your memory?
transliteration: Nín zhùyì dào zìjǐ de jìyìlì yǒu biànhuà ma?
translation: 您注意到自己的记忆力有变化吗？

english: Do you find it difficult to organize tasks?
transliteration: Nín juéde ānpái shìqing hěn kùnnan ma?
translation: 您觉得安排事情很困难吗？

english: Have you been feeling confused?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn juéde hútu ma?
translation: 您最近觉得糊涂吗？

english: Has anyone noticed a change in your behaviour?
transliteration: Yǒu rén zhùyì dào nín de xíngwéi yǒu biànhuà ma?
translation: 有人注意到您的行为有变化吗？

english: Can you tell me your full name?
transliteration: Nín néng gàosu wǒ nín de quánmíng ma?
translation: 您能告诉我您的全名吗？

english: Can you tell me today’s date?
transliteration: Nín néng gàosu wǒ jīntiān shì jǐ hào ma?
translation: 您能告诉我今天是几号吗？

english: Can you tell me where we are right now?
transliteration: Nín néng gàosu wǒmen xiànzài zài nǎlǐ ma?
translation: 您能告诉我我们现在在哪里吗？

english: I will say three words; please repeat them.
transliteration: Wǒ huì shuō sān ge cí, qǐng nín chóngfù yí biàn.
translation: 我会说三个词，请您重复一遍。

english: Please try to remember those words for later.
transliteration: Qǐng nín jǐnliàng jìzhù zhèxiē cí, shāohòu wǒ huì zài wèn nín.
translation: 请您尽量记住这些词，稍后我会再问您。

english: Can you tell me those three words now?
transliteration: Nín xiànzài néng gàosu wǒ nà sān ge cí ma?
translation: 您现在能告诉我那三个词吗？

english: Can you spell a word backwards?
transliteration: Nín néng bǎ yí ge cí dàozhe pīn chūlái ma?
translation: 您能把一个词倒着拼出来吗？

english: What do you think is causing these difficulties?
transliteration: Nín juéde zhèxiē kùnnan shì shénme yuányīn zàochéng de?
translation: 您觉得这些困难是什么原因造成的？

english: How would you describe your mood today?
transliteration: Nín jīntiān de xīnqíng zěnmeyàng?
translation: 您今天的心情怎么样？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you ever seen a psychiatrist or counsellor?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián kàn guo jīngshénkē yīshēng huò xīnlǐ zīxúnshī ma?
translation: 您以前看过精神科医生或心理咨询师吗？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you ever been admitted to hospital for mental health care?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián yīn xīnlǐ jiànkāng wèntí zhù guo yuàn ma?
translation: 您以前因心理健康问题住过院吗？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Has anyone in your family had mental health difficulties?
transliteration: Nín de jiārén zhōng yǒu rén yǒu guo xīnlǐ jiànkāng fāngmiàn de kùnnan ma?
translation: 您的家人中有人有过心理健康方面的困难吗？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Do you have any medical conditions?
transliteration: Nín yǒu rènhé shēntǐ jíbìng ma?
translation: 您有任何身体疾病吗？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Who do you live with?
transliteration: Nín hé shéi zhù zài yìqǐ?
translation: 您和谁住在一起？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Who can you turn to for support?
transliteration: Nín kěyǐ xiàng shéi xúnqiú bāngzhù?
translation: 您可以向谁寻求帮助？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you had recent financial or housing difficulties?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn zài jīngjì huò zhùfáng fāngmiàn yùdào kùnnan le ma?
translation: 您最近在经济或住房方面遇到困难了吗？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Are your relationships causing you stress?
transliteration: Nín de rénjì guānxì ràng nín gǎndào yǒu yālì ma?
translation: 您的人际关系让您感到有压力吗？

english: What medicines are you taking now?
transliteration: Nín xiànzài zài chī nǎxiē yào?
translation: 您现在在吃哪些药？

english: Do you take antidepressant medication?
transliteration: Nín zài fúyòng kàngyìyù yào ma?
translation: 您在服用抗抑郁药吗？

english: Do you take medicine for anxiety?
transliteration: Nín zài fúyòng zhìliáo jiāolǜ de yào ma?
translation: 您在服用治疗焦虑的药吗？

english: Do you take antipsychotic medication?
transliteration: Nín zài fúyòng kàng jīngshénbìng yào ma?
translation: 您在服用抗精神病药吗？

english: Do you take a mood stabilizer?
transliteration: Nín zài fúyòng xīnjìng wěndìngjì ma?
translation: 您在服用心境稳定剂吗？

english: Do you take sleeping pills or benzodiazepines?
transliteration: Nín zài fúyòng ānmián yào huò běn èr dàn zhuō lèi yàowù ma?
translation: 您在服用安眠药或苯二氮䓬类药物吗？

english: What dose do you take and how often?
transliteration: Nín měi cì fúyòng duōshǎo jìliàng? Duōjiǔ fúyòng yí cì?
translation: 您每次服用多少剂量？多久服用一次？

english: How long have you been taking this medicine?
transliteration: Nín fúyòng zhè zhǒng yào duōjiǔ le?
translation: 您服用这种药多久了？

english: Have you missed any doses recently?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn lòu fú guo yào ma?
translation: 您最近漏服过药吗？

english: Has the medicine been helping?
transliteration: Zhè zhǒng yào duì nín yǒu bāngzhù ma?
translation: 这种药对您有帮助吗？

english: Have you noticed any side effects?
transliteration: Nín zhùyì dào yǒu shénme fùzuòyòng ma?
translation: 您注意到有什么副作用吗？

english: Have you stopped any medication recently?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn tíng guo rènhé yào ma?
translation: 您最近停过任何药吗？

english: What are your goals for treatment?
transliteration: Nín duì zhìliáo yǒu shénme mùbiāo?
translation: 您对治疗有什么目标？

english: Would you be interested in talking therapy or counselling?
transliteration: Nín yǒu xìngqù jiēshòu tánhuà zhìliáo huò xīnlǐ zīxún ma?
translation: 您有兴趣接受谈话治疗或心理咨询吗？

english: We can discuss medication options together.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ tǎolùn yòngyào xuǎnzé.
translation: 我们可以一起讨论用药选择。

english: Some medicines take several weeks to work fully.
transliteration: Yǒuxiē yào xūyào jǐ zhōu cái néng chōngfèn fāhuī zuòyòng.
translation: 有些药需要几周才能充分发挥作用。

english: Please speak with your clinician before stopping medication.
transliteration: Tíng yào qián qǐng xiān hé nín de yīhù rényuán tán tan.
translation: 停药前请先和您的医护人员谈谈。

english: Would you like us to involve a trusted family member?
transliteration: Nín yuànyì ràng yí wèi nín xìnrèn de jiārén cānyù jìnlái ma?
translation: 您愿意让一位您信任的家人参与进来吗？

english: We can make a plan for what to do if symptoms worsen.
transliteration: Rúguǒ zhèngzhuàng jiāzhòng, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ zhìdìng yìngduì jìhuà.
translation: 如果症状加重，我们可以一起制定应对计划。

english: What concerns do you have about treatment?
transliteration: Nín duì zhìliáo yǒu shénme gùlǜ?
translation: 您对治疗有什么顾虑？

english: Do you feel safe going home today?
transliteration: Nín juéde jīntiān huí jiā ānquán ma?
translation: 您觉得今天回家安全吗？

english: Who could you call if you felt unsafe?
transliteration: Rúguǒ nín juéde bù ānquán, kěyǐ gěi shéi dǎ diànhuà?
translation: 如果您觉得不安全，可以给谁打电话？

english: Can we identify warning signs that things are getting worse?
transliteration: Wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ zhǎo chū qíngkuàng èhuà de yùjǐng xìnhào ma?
translation: 我们可以一起找出情况恶化的预警信号吗？

english: If you are in immediate danger, seek emergency help.
transliteration: Rúguǒ nín zhèng miànlín jǐnjí wēixiǎn, qǐng xúnqiú jíjiù bāngzhù.
translation: 如果您正面临紧急危险，请寻求急救帮助。

english: We can arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěyǐ wèi nín ānpái yí cì fùzhěn.
translation: 我们可以为您安排一次复诊。

english: Would you like information about local support services?
transliteration: Nín xiǎng liǎojiě běndì de zhīchí fúwù ma?
translation: 您想了解本地的支持服务吗？

english: Is there anything else you would like to ask?
transliteration: Nín hái yǒu shénme xiǎng wèn de ma?
translation: 您还有什么想问的吗？

english: I am going to ask some questions about your symptoms.
transliteration: Wǒ jiēxiàlái huì wèn nín yìxiē yǒuguān zhèngzhuàng de wèntí.
translation: 我接下来会问您一些有关症状的问题。

english: When did your symptoms first begin?
transliteration: Nín de zhèngzhuàng zuìzǎo shì shénme shíhou kāishǐ de?
translation: 您的症状最早是什么时候开始的？

english: Did the symptoms start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: Zhèngzhuàng shì tūrán chūxiàn de, háishi mànman chūxiàn de?
translation: 症状是突然出现的，还是慢慢出现的？

english: What were you doing when this started?
transliteration: Zhèngzhuàng kāishǐ shí, nín zhèngzài zuò shénme?
translation: 症状开始时，您正在做什么？

english: Are the symptoms constant or do they come and go?
transliteration: Zhèngzhuàng shì yìzhí chíxù, háishi shí yǒu shí wú?
translation: 症状是一直持续，还是时有时无？

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: Měi cì fāzuò huì chíxù duōjiǔ?
translation: 每次发作会持续多久？

english: How many times a day or week does this happen?
transliteration: Zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng měitiān huò měi zhōu huì fāshēng jǐ cì?
translation: 这种情况每天或每周会发生几次？

english: Are your symptoms getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: Nín de zhèngzhuàng shì zài hǎozhuǎn, jiāzhòng, háishi méiyǒu biànhuà?
translation: 您的症状是在好转、加重，还是没有变化？

english: Have you ever had this problem before?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián yǒu guo zhège wèntí ma?
translation: 您以前有过这个问题吗？

english: Does anything make it better or worse?
transliteration: Yǒu shénme huì ràng qíngkuàng hǎozhuǎn huò jiāzhòng ma?
translation: 有什么会让情况好转或加重吗？

english: Please tell me immediately if you feel unwell during the examination.
transliteration: Jiǎnchá guòchéng zhōng, rúguǒ nín juéde bù shūfu, qǐng mǎshàng gàosu wǒ.
translation: 检查过程中，如果您觉得不舒服，请马上告诉我。

english: Did you suddenly develop weakness on one side of your body?
transliteration: Nín shēntǐ yí cè yǒu méiyǒu tūrán wúlì?
translation: 您身体一侧有没有突然无力？

english: Did one side of your face suddenly droop?
transliteration: Nín de yí cè liǎn yǒu méiyǒu tūrán xiàchuí?
translation: 您的一侧脸有没有突然下垂？

english: Did you suddenly have trouble speaking?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu tūrán shuōhuà kùnnan?
translation: 您有没有突然说话困难？

english: Did you suddenly have trouble understanding speech?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu tūrán tīng bu dǒng biérén shuō de huà?
translation: 您有没有突然听不懂别人说的话？

english: Did you suddenly lose vision in one or both eyes?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu tūrán yì zhī yǎn huò shuāngyǎn shīmíng?
translation: 您有没有突然一只眼或双眼失明？

english: Did you suddenly lose your balance or coordination?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu tūrán shīqù pínghéng huò xiétiáo nénglì?
translation: 您有没有突然失去平衡或协调能力？

english: What time were you last completely well?
transliteration: Nín zuìhòu yí cì wánquán méiyǒu bù shūfu shì shénme shíhou?
translation: 您最后一次完全没有不舒服是什么时候？

english: Did the symptoms go away completely?
transliteration: Zhèngzhuàng yǒu méiyǒu wánquán xiāoshī?
translation: 症状有没有完全消失？

english: Did you have the worst headache of your life?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu jīnglì guo zhè bèizi zuì yánzhòng de tóutòng?
translation: 您有没有经历过这辈子最严重的头痛？

english: Did the headache reach maximum intensity within seconds or a minute?
transliteration: Tóutòng yǒu méiyǒu zài jǐ miǎo zhōng huò yì fēnzhōng nèi dádào zuì yánzhòng de chéngdù?
translation: 头痛有没有在几秒钟或一分钟内达到最严重的程度？

english: Do you have a fever with a stiff neck?
transliteration: Nín fāshāo shí bózi jiāngyìng ma?
translation: 您发烧时脖子僵硬吗？

english: Have you had a new seizure or lost consciousness?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn yǒu méiyǒu xīnfā diānxián fāzuò huò shīqù yìshí?
translation: 您最近有没有新发癫痫发作或失去意识？

english: Do you have new difficulty controlling your bladder or bowels?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn yǒu méiyǒu xīn chūxiàn kòngzhì bu zhù dàxiǎobiàn de qíngkuàng?
translation: 您最近有没有新出现控制不住大小便的情况？

english: Do you have numbness around your groin or buttocks?
transliteration: Nín de fùgǔgōu huò túnbù zhōuwéi yǒu mámù gǎn ma?
translation: 您的腹股沟或臀部周围有麻木感吗？

english: Where exactly is your headache?
transliteration: Nín de tóutòng jùtǐ zài nǎlǐ?
translation: 您的头痛具体在哪里？

english: Is the pain on one side or both sides of your head?
transliteration: Nín de tóu shì yí cè tòng háishi liǎng cè dōu tòng?
translation: 您的头是一侧痛还是两侧都痛？

english: Does the pain spread to your neck, face, or behind your eyes?
transliteration: Téngtòng huì kuòsàn dào nín de bózi, liǎnbù huò yǎnjing hòumian ma?
translation: 疼痛会扩散到您的脖子、脸部或眼睛后面吗？

english: Is the pain throbbing, pressing, stabbing, or burning?
transliteration: Téngtòng shì tiàotòng, yāpòtòng, cìtòng háishi zhuótòng?
translation: 疼痛是跳痛、压迫痛、刺痛还是灼痛？

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: Qǐng yòng líng dào shí fēn biǎoshì, téngtòng yǒu duō yánzhòng?
translation: 请用0到10分表示，疼痛有多严重？

english: Does light or noise bother you during the headache?
transliteration: Tóutòng shí, guāngxiàn huò zàoyīn huì ràng nín bù shūfu ma?
translation: 头痛时，光线或噪音会让您不舒服吗？

english: Do you feel nauseated or vomit with the headache?
transliteration: Tóutòng shí nín huì juéde ěxīn huò ǒutù ma?
translation: 头痛时您会觉得恶心或呕吐吗？

english: Do you see flashing lights or zigzag lines before the headache?
transliteration: Tóutòng qián nín huì kàndào shǎnguāng huò jùchǐ zhuàng xiàntiáo ma?
translation: 头痛前您会看到闪光或锯齿状线条吗？

english: Does physical activity make the headache worse?
transliteration: Shēntǐ huódòng huì ràng tóutòng jiāzhòng ma?
translation: 身体活动会让头痛加重吗？

english: Does coughing, straining, or bending make it worse?
transliteration: Késòu, yònglì huò wānyāo huì ràng qíngkuàng biàn de gèng zāo ma?
translation: 咳嗽、用力或弯腰会让情况变得更糟吗？

english: Is the headache worse when lying down or standing up?
transliteration: Tǎngxià huò zhàn qǐlái shí, tóutòng huì gèng yánzhòng ma?
translation: 躺下或站起来时，头痛会更严重吗？

english: Does the headache wake you from sleep?
transliteration: Tóutòng huì bǎ nín cóng shuìmèng zhōng tòng xǐng ma?
translation: 头痛会把您从睡梦中痛醒吗？

english: Have your headaches changed recently?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn de tóutòng yǒu biànhuà ma?
translation: 您最近的头痛有变化吗？

english: How many days each month do you have a headache?
transliteration: Nín měi ge yuè yǒu jǐ tiān huì tóutòng?
translation: 您每个月有几天会头痛？

english: How often do you take painkillers for headaches?
transliteration: Nín duō cháng fúyòng zhǐtòngyào lái huǎnjiě tóutòng?
translation: 您多常服用止痛药来缓解头痛？

english: Do you feel the room spinning or do you feel faint?
transliteration: Nín juéde fángjiān zài xuánzhuǎn, háishi juéde kuài yào yūndǎo?
translation: 您觉得房间在旋转，还是觉得快要晕倒？

english: Do you feel unsteady when walking?
transliteration: Zǒulù shí nín huì juéde zhàn bù wěn ma?
translation: 走路时您会觉得站不稳吗？

english: Does turning your head trigger the dizziness?
transliteration: Zhuǎn tóu huì yǐnfā tóuyūn ma?
translation: 转头会引发头晕吗？

english: Does standing up trigger the dizziness?
transliteration: Zhàn qǐlái huì yǐnfā tóuyūn ma?
translation: 站起来会引发头晕吗？

english: Does the dizziness last seconds, minutes, hours, or longer?
transliteration: Tóuyūn huì chíxù jǐ miǎo, jǐ fēnzhōng, jǐ xiǎoshí, háishi gèng jiǔ?
translation: 头晕会持续几秒、几分钟、几小时，还是更久？

english: Do you have ringing in your ears or hearing loss?
transliteration: Nín yǒu ěrmíng huò tīnglì xiàjiàng ma?
translation: 您有耳鸣或听力下降吗？

english: Have you fallen because of the dizziness?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu yīnwèi tóuyūn ér shuāidǎo guo?
translation: 您有没有因为头晕而摔倒过？

english: Can you walk without assistance?
transliteration: Nín bù xūyào biérén bāngmáng yě néng zǒulù ma?
translation: 您不需要别人帮忙也能走路吗？

english: Do you feel weakness in your arms or legs?
transliteration: Nín de shǒubì huò tuǐ huì juéde wúlì ma?
translation: 您的手臂或腿会觉得无力吗？

english: Is one side weaker than the other?
transliteration: Yí cè bǐ lìng yí cè gèng wúlì ma?
translation: 一侧比另一侧更无力吗？

english: Do you have trouble lifting your arms above your head?
transliteration: Nín bǎ shǒubì jǔ guò tóudǐng shí huì juéde kùnnan ma?
translation: 您把手臂举过头顶时会觉得困难吗？

english: Do you have trouble standing up from a chair?
transliteration: Nín cóng yǐzi shàng zhàn qǐlái huì juéde kùnnan ma?
translation: 您从椅子上站起来会觉得困难吗？

english: Do you trip because your foot drags?
transliteration: Nín huì yīnwèi jiǎo tuōzhe dì zǒu ér bàndǎo ma?
translation: 您会因为脚拖着地走而绊倒吗？

english: Do you drop objects from your hands?
transliteration: Nín shǒu lǐ de dōngxi huì diào xiàlái ma?
translation: 您手里的东西会掉下来吗？

english: Does the weakness get worse with repeated activity?
transliteration: Fǎnfù huódòng hòu, wúlìgǎn huì jiāzhòng ma?
translation: 反复活动后，无力感会加重吗？

english: Does resting improve the weakness?
transliteration: Xiūxi hòu, wúlìgǎn huì hǎo yìxiē ma?
translation: 休息后，无力感会好一些吗？

english: Have you noticed muscle twitching or cramps?
transliteration: Nín zhùyì dào jīròu chōudòng huò chōujīn le ma?
translation: 您注意到肌肉抽动或抽筋了吗？

english: Have your muscles become smaller over time?
transliteration: Nín de jīròu suí zhe shíjiān tuīyí biàn xiǎo le ma?
translation: 您的肌肉随着时间推移变小了吗？

english: Do you have numbness or tingling anywhere?
transliteration: Nín shēntǐ nǎlǐ yǒu mámù huò cìtòng gǎn ma?
translation: 您身体哪里有麻木或刺痛感吗？

english: Where does the numbness begin and where does it spread?
transliteration: Mámù cóng nǎlǐ kāishǐ, yòu kuòsàn dào nǎlǐ?
translation: 麻木从哪里开始，又扩散到哪里？

english: Is the numbness in both hands or both feet?
transliteration: Nín de liǎng zhī shǒu huò liǎng zhī jiǎo dōu yǒu mámù gǎn ma?
translation: 您的两只手或两只脚都有麻木感吗？

english: Do you feel burning or electric-shock-like pain?
transliteration: Nín huì juéde zhuótòng, huò xiàng chùdiàn yíyàng téng ma?
translation: 您会觉得灼痛，或像触电一样疼吗？

english: Does the pain travel from your back down your leg?
transliteration: Téngtòng huì cóng bèibù yánzhe tuǐ wǎng xià yánshēn ma?
translation: 疼痛会从背部沿着腿往下延伸吗？

english: Can you feel hot and cold normally?
transliteration: Nín néng zhèngcháng gǎnjué lěng rè ma?
translation: 您能正常感觉冷热吗？

english: Does touching the skin cause unusual pain?
transliteration: Chùpèng pífū huì yǐnqǐ yìcháng téngtòng ma?
translation: 触碰皮肤会引起异常疼痛吗？

english: Have you ever had a seizure or fit?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián yǒu guo diānxián fāzuò ma?
translation: 您以前有过癫痫发作吗？

english: Did anyone see what happened during the episode?
transliteration: Fāzuò shí yǒu rén kàndào fāshēng le shénme ma?
translation: 发作时有人看到发生了什么吗？

english: Did your arms or legs shake uncontrollably?
transliteration: Nín de shǒubì huò tuǐ dāngshí yǒu méiyǒu bù shòu kòngzhì de chōudòng?
translation: 您的手臂或腿当时有没有不受控制地抽动？

english: Did you lose awareness of your surroundings?
transliteration: Nín dāngshí yǒu méiyǒu shīqù duì zhōuwéi huánjìng de yìshí?
translation: 您当时有没有失去对周围环境的意识？

english: Did you bite your tongue?
transliteration: Nín yǎo dào shétou le ma?
translation: 您咬到舌头了吗？

english: Did you lose control of your bladder?
transliteration: Nín dāngshí yǒu méiyǒu shīqù duì pángguāng de kòngzhì?
translation: 您当时有没有失去对膀胱的控制？

english: Were you confused or sleepy afterward?
transliteration: Zhīhòu nín yǒu méiyǒu gǎndào míhu huò kùnjuàn?
translation: 之后您有没有感到迷糊或困倦？

english: Did you notice a strange smell, feeling, or warning before the episode?
transliteration: Fāzuò qián, nín yǒu méiyǒu wéndào qíguài de qìwèi, gǎndào qíguài de gǎnjué, huò chūxiàn yùjǐng?
translation: 发作前，您有没有闻到奇怪的气味、感到奇怪的感觉，或出现预警？

english: How long did it take to return to normal?
transliteration: Guò le duō jiǔ nín cái huīfù zhèngcháng?
translation: 过了多久您才恢复正常？

english: Have you missed any doses of your seizure medicine?
transliteration: Nín de kàng diānxián yào yǒu méiyǒu lòu fú?
translation: 您的抗癫痫药有没有漏服？

english: Do your hands shake when resting or when using them?
transliteration: Nín de shǒu zài xiūxi shí huò shǐyòng shí huì fādǒu ma?
translation: 您的手在休息时或使用时会发抖吗？

english: Does the shaking affect one hand or both?
transliteration: Fādǒu yǐngxiǎng yì zhī shǒu háishi liǎng zhī shǒu?
translation: 发抖影响一只手还是两只手？

english: Has your handwriting become smaller?
transliteration: Nín de zìjì biàn xiǎo le ma?
translation: 您的字迹变小了吗？

english: Do you feel stiff or move more slowly?
transliteration: Nín juéde shēntǐ jiāngyìng huò dòngzuò biàn màn le ma?
translation: 您觉得身体僵硬或动作变慢了吗？

english: Have you had difficulty starting to walk?
transliteration: Nín kāishǐ zǒulù shí huì juéde kùnnan ma?
translation: 您开始走路时会觉得困难吗？

english: Do you freeze or feel stuck while walking?
transliteration: Zǒulù shí nín huì tūrán mài bù kāi bù huò juéde bèi kǎzhù ma?
translation: 走路时您会突然迈不开步或觉得被卡住吗？

english: Have you noticed changes in your voice or facial expression?
transliteration: Nín zhùyì dào shēngyīn huò miànbù biǎoqíng yǒu biànhuà ma?
translation: 您注意到声音或面部表情有变化吗？

english: Have you been forgetting recent conversations or appointments?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn cháng wàngjì tán guo de huà huò yuēhuì ma?
translation: 您最近常忘记谈过的话或约会吗？

english: Do you have trouble finding the right words?
transliteration: Nín huì zhǎo bu dào héshì de cí lái biǎodá ma?
translation: 您会找不到合适的词来表达吗？

english: Have you become lost in familiar places?
transliteration: Nín zài shúxī de dìfang yě huì mílù ma?
translation: 您在熟悉的地方也会迷路吗？

english: Do you have difficulty managing medicines or finances?
transliteration: Nín guǎnlǐ yàowù huò cáiwù shí huì juéde kùnnan ma?
translation: 您管理药物或财务时会觉得困难吗？

english: Have you noticed changes in your mood or behaviour?
transliteration: Nín zhùyì dào zìjǐ de qíngxù huò xíngwéi yǒu biànhuà ma?
translation: 您注意到自己的情绪或行为有变化吗？

english: Do you have trouble concentrating?
transliteration: Nín huì juéde nányǐ jízhōng zhùyìlì ma?
translation: 您会觉得难以集中注意力吗？

english: Has your speech become slurred?
transliteration: Nín shuōhuà biàn de hánhu bù qīng le ma?
translation: 您说话变得含糊不清了吗？

english: Do you have trouble swallowing food or liquids?
transliteration: Nín tūnyàn shíwù huò yètǐ shí huì juéde kùnnan ma?
translation: 您吞咽食物或液体时会觉得困难吗？

english: Do you see double?
transliteration: Nín kàn dōngxi huì chóngyǐng ma?
translation: 您看东西会重影吗？

english: Does the double vision go away when you cover one eye?
transliteration: Zhē zhù yì zhī yǎnjing hòu, chóngyǐng huì xiāoshī ma?
translation: 遮住一只眼睛后，重影会消失吗？

english: Have you noticed a drooping eyelid?
transliteration: Nín zhùyì dào yǎnpí xiàchuí le ma?
translation: 您注意到眼皮下垂了吗？

english: Do you have numbness or pain in your face?
transliteration: Nín de liǎn yǒu mámù gǎn huò téngtòng ma?
translation: 您的脸有麻木感或疼痛吗？

english: Have you noticed weakness on one side of your face?
transliteration: Nín zhùyì dào yí cè liǎnbù wúlì le ma?
translation: 您注意到一侧脸部无力了吗？

english: Have you noticed changes in your hearing?
transliteration: Nín zhùyì dào tīnglì yǒu biànhuà ma?
translation: 您注意到听力有变化吗？

english: Do you choke or cough when swallowing?
transliteration: Tūnyàn shí nín huì qiàng dào huò késòu ma?
translation: 吞咽时您会呛到或咳嗽吗？

english: Have you ever had a stroke or a mini-stroke?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián dé guo zhòngfēng huò xiǎo zhòngfēng ma?
translation: 您以前得过中风或小中风吗？

english: Have you ever had a head injury or concussion?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián tóubù shòu guo shāng huò nǎo zhèndàng ma?
translation: 您以前头部受过伤或脑震荡吗？

english: Have you ever had meningitis or a brain infection?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián dé guo nǎomóyán huò nǎobù gǎnrǎn ma?
translation: 您以前得过脑膜炎或脑部感染吗？

english: Do you have diabetes, high blood pressure, or high cholesterol?
transliteration: Nín yǒu tángniàobìng, gāo xuèyā huò gāo dǎngùchún ma?
translation: 您有糖尿病、高血压或高胆固醇吗？

english: Does anyone in your family have migraines, seizures, or a neurological condition?
transliteration: Nín jiālǐ yǒu rén huànyǒu piāntóutòng, diānxián huò shénjīng xìtǒng jíbìng ma?
translation: 您家里有人患有偏头痛、癫痫或神经系统疾病吗？

english: What medicines do you take regularly?
transliteration: Nín píngshí guīlǜ fúyòng nǎxiē yào?
translation: 您平时 नियमित服用哪些药？

english: What is the name and dose of your seizure medicine?
transliteration: Nín de kàng diānxián yào jiào shénme míngzi, jìliàng shì duōshao?
translation: 您的抗癫痫药叫什么名字，剂量是多少？

english: How long have you been taking this medicine?
transliteration: Nín fúyòng zhè zhǒng yào duō jiǔ le?
translation: 您服用这种药多久了？

english: Have you recently started, stopped, or changed a medicine?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn kāishǐ fúyòng, tíngyòng huò gēnghuàn guo yàowù ma?
translation: 您最近开始服用、停用或更换过药物吗？

english: Has this medicine helped your symptoms?
transliteration: Zhè zhǒng yào duì nín de zhèngzhuàng yǒu bāngzhù ma?
translation: 这种药对您的症状有帮助吗？

english: Have you noticed any side effects?
transliteration: Nín zhùyì dào rènhé fùzuòyòng le ma?
translation: 您注意到任何副作用了吗？

english: Do you drink alcohol or use recreational drugs?
transliteration: Nín hējiǔ huò shǐyòng yúlèxìng yàowù ma?
translation: 您喝酒或使用娱乐性药物吗？

english: Can you tell me your full name?
transliteration: Nín néng gàosu wǒ nín de quánmíng ma?
translation: 您能告诉我您的全名吗？

english: Can you tell me today's date?
transliteration: Nín néng gàosu wǒ jīntiān de rìqī ma?
translation: 您能告诉我今天的日期吗？

english: Can you tell me where we are right now?
transliteration: Nín néng gàosu wǒ wǒmen xiànzài zài nǎlǐ ma?
translation: 您能告诉我我们现在在哪里吗？

english: Please repeat these three words after me.
transliteration: Qǐng gēn wǒ chóngfù zhè sān ge cí.
translation: 请跟我重复这三个词。

english: Please remember these words; I will ask you again later.
transliteration: Qǐng jìzhù zhè jǐ ge cí, wǒ shāohòu huì zài wèn nín.
translation: 请记住这几个词，我稍后会再问您。

english: Please name this object.
transliteration: Qǐng shuō chū zhège wùpǐn de míngchēng.
translation: 请说出这个物品的名称。

english: Please follow this two-step instruction.
transliteration: Qǐng àn zhè liǎng bù zhǐshì zuò.
translation: 请按这两步指示做。

english: Please read this sentence aloud.
transliteration: Qǐng dàshēng dú chū zhège jùzi.
translation: 请大声读出这个句子。

english: Please write a complete sentence.
transliteration: Qǐng xiě yí ge wánzhěng de jùzi.
translation: 请写一个完整的句子。

english: Please copy this drawing.
transliteration: Qǐng zhàozhe zhè fú tú huà yí biàn.
translation: 请照着这幅图画一遍。

english: I am going to check your eye movements and facial muscles.
transliteration: Wǒ huì jiǎnchá nín de yǎnqiú huódòng hé miànbù jīròu.
translation: 我会检查您的眼球活动和面部肌肉。

english: Please look straight ahead.
transliteration: Qǐng kàn qiánfāng.
translation: 请看前方。

english: Follow my finger with your eyes without moving your head.
transliteration: Tóu bú yào dòng, yòng yǎnjing gēnzhe wǒ de shǒuzhǐ kàn.
translation: 头不要动，用眼睛跟着我的手指看。

english: Please cover one eye.
transliteration: Qǐng zhē zhù yì zhī yǎnjing.
translation: 请遮住一只眼睛。

english: Tell me when you can see my moving finger.
transliteration: Kàndào wǒ de shǒuzhǐ zài dòng shí, qǐng gàosu wǒ.
translation: 看到我的手指在动时，请告诉我。

english: I am going to shine a light into your eyes.
transliteration: Wǒ huì yòng dēngguāng zhào yíxià nín de yǎnjing.
translation: 我会用灯光照一下您的眼睛。

english: Please raise your eyebrows.
transliteration: Qǐng tái qǐ méimao.
translation: 请抬起眉毛。

english: Please close your eyes tightly.
transliteration: Qǐng yònglì bì shàng yǎnjing.
translation: 请用力闭上眼睛。

english: Please smile and show your teeth.
transliteration: Qǐng wēixiào bìng lù chū yáchǐ.
translation: 请微笑并露出牙齿。

english: Please puff out your cheeks.
transliteration: Qǐng gǔ qǐ liǎnjiá.
translation: 请鼓起脸颊。

english: Does this feel the same on both sides of your face?
transliteration: Nín liǎn de liǎng cè gǎnjué yíyàng ma?
translation: 您脸的两侧感觉一样吗？

english: Please open your mouth and say ah.
transliteration: Qǐng zhāng kāi zuǐ shuō “ā”.
translation: 请张开嘴说“啊”。

english: Please stick out your tongue.
transliteration: Qǐng shēn chū shétou.
translation: 请伸出舌头。

english: Please shrug your shoulders against my hands.
transliteration: Qǐng dǐ zhù wǒ de shǒu, sǒng qǐ jiānbǎng.
translation: 请抵住我的手，耸起肩膀。

english: Please turn your head against my hand.
transliteration: Qǐng dǐ zhù wǒ de shǒu, zhuǎndòng tóubù.
translation: 请抵住我的手，转动头部。

english: Please hold both arms straight out in front of you.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ shuāng bì shēn zhí, píng jǔ zài shēn qián.
translation: 请把双臂伸直，平举在身前。

english: Turn your palms upward and close your eyes.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ shǒu zhǎng cháo shàng, rán hòu bì shàng yǎn jing.
translation: 请把手掌朝上，然后闭上眼睛。

english: Please squeeze my fingers.
transliteration: Qǐng yòng lì wò wǒ de shǒu zhǐ.
translation: 请用力握我的手指。

english: Please push against my hand.
transliteration: Qǐng yòng lì tuī wǒ de shǒu.
translation: 请用力推我的手。

english: Please pull against my hand.
transliteration: Qǐng yòng lì lā wǒ de shǒu.
translation: 请用力拉我的手。

english: Please lift your leg off the bed.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ tuǐ tái lí chuáng miàn.
translation: 请把腿抬离床面。

english: Please bend your knee.
transliteration: Qǐng wān qū xī gài.
translation: 请弯曲膝盖。

english: Please straighten your knee.
transliteration: Qǐng shēn zhí xī gài.
translation: 请伸直膝盖。

english: Please pull your toes up toward your head.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ jiǎo zhǐ cháo tóu de fāng xiàng tái qǐ lái.
translation: 请把脚趾朝头的方向抬起来。

english: Please push your foot down like pressing a pedal.
transliteration: Qǐng xiàng cǎi tà bǎn yí yàng bǎ jiǎo wǎng xià cǎi.
translation: 请像踩踏板一样把脚往下踩。

english: Please relax while I move your arm.
transliteration: Wǒ huó dòng nín de shǒu bì shí, qǐng fàng sōng.
translation: 我活动您的手臂时，请放松。

english: Please close your eyes while I check your sensation.
transliteration: Wǒ jiǎn chá nín de gǎn jué shí, qǐng bì shàng yǎn jing.
translation: 我检查您的感觉时，请闭上眼睛。

english: Can you feel me touching you here?
transliteration: Wǒ pèng zhè lǐ shí, nín néng gǎn jué dào ma?
translation: 我碰这里时，您能感觉到吗？

english: Does it feel the same on the left and right?
transliteration: Zuǒ biān hé yòu biān de gǎn jué yí yàng ma?
translation: 左边和右边的感觉一样吗？

english: Tell me whether this feels sharp or dull.
transliteration: Qǐng gào su wǒ, zhè gǎn jué shì jiān ruì hái shì chí dùn.
translation: 请告诉我，这感觉是尖锐还是迟钝。

english: Tell me whether this feels warm or cold.
transliteration: Qǐng gào su wǒ, zhè gǎn jué shì wēn hái shì liáng.
translation: 请告诉我，这感觉是温还是凉。

english: Tell me which way I move your finger or toe.
transliteration: Qǐng gào su wǒ, wǒ bǎ nín de shǒu zhǐ huò jiǎo zhǐ wǎng nǎ ge fāng xiàng dòng.
translation: 请告诉我，我把您的手指或脚趾往哪个方向动。

english: I am going to tap your knee gently to check your reflexes.
transliteration: Wǒ huì qīng qīng qiāo yí xià nín de xī gài, jiǎn chá fǎn shè.
translation: 我会轻轻敲一下您的膝盖，检查反射。

english: Please let your arm or leg relax.
transliteration: Qǐng fàng sōng nín de shǒu bì huò tuǐ.
translation: 请放松您的手臂或腿。

english: Please touch your nose and then my finger.
transliteration: Qǐng xiān mō nín de bí zi, zài mō wǒ de shǒu zhǐ.
translation: 请先摸您的鼻子，再摸我的手指。

english: Please do that again a little faster.
transliteration: Qǐng zài zuò yí cì, shāo wēi kuài yì diǎn.
translation: 请再做一次，稍微快一点。

english: Please tap your hands on your thighs, turning them over quickly.
transliteration: Qǐng yòng shuāng shǒu kuài sù jiāo tì pāi dǎ dà tuǐ, shǒu zhǎng fān lái fān qù.
translation: 请用双手快速交替拍打大腿，手掌翻来翻去。

english: Please slide your heel down your other shin.
transliteration: Qǐng yòng jiǎo gēn yán zhe lìng yì tiáo xiǎo tuǐ wǎng xià huá.
translation: 请用脚跟沿着另一条小腿往下滑。

english: Please stand with your feet together.
transliteration: Qǐng shuāng jiǎo bìng lǒng zhàn hǎo.
translation: 请双脚并拢站好。

english: Please close your eyes while standing; I will stay beside you.
transliteration: Qǐng zhàn zhe bì shàng yǎn jing; wǒ huì zài nín shēn biān.
translation: 请站着闭上眼睛；我会在您身边。

english: Please walk across the room and back.
transliteration: Qǐng zǒu dào fáng jiān nà tóu, zài zǒu huí lái.
translation: 请走到房间那头，再走回来。

english: Please walk heel to toe in a straight line.
transliteration: Qǐng yán zhí xiàn zǒu lù, ràng hòu yì zhī jiǎo de jiǎo gēn jiē zhe qián yì zhī jiǎo de jiǎo jiān.
translation: 请沿直线走路，让后一只脚的脚跟接着前一只脚的脚尖。

english: Please walk on your heels.
transliteration: Qǐng yòng jiǎo gēn zǒu lù.
translation: 请用脚跟走路。

english: Please walk on your toes.
transliteration: Qǐng diǎn zhe jiǎo jiān zǒu lù.
translation: 请踮着脚尖走路。

english: Please turn around and walk back.
transliteration: Qǐng zhuǎn shēn, rán hòu zǒu huí lái.
translation: 请转身，然后走回来。

english: We may need a CT scan of your head.
transliteration: Wǒ men kě néng xū yào gěi nín de tóu bù zuò CT sǎo miáo.
translation: 我们可能需要给您的头部做CT扫描。

english: We may need an MRI scan of your brain or spine.
transliteration: Wǒ men kě néng xū yào gěi nín de nǎo bù huò jǐ zhù zuò MRI sǎo miáo.
translation: 我们可能需要给您的脑部或脊柱做MRI扫描。

english: An EEG records the electrical activity of your brain.
transliteration: Nǎo diàn tú (EEG) huì jì lù nín dà nǎo de diàn huó dòng.
translation: 脑电图（EEG）会记录您大脑的电活动。

english: A nerve conduction study checks how your nerves send signals.
transliteration: Shén jīng chuán dǎo jiǎn chá huì jiǎn chá nín de shén jīng rú hé chuán dì xìn hào.
translation: 神经传导检查会检查您的神经如何传递信号。

english: A lumbar puncture takes a small sample of fluid from your lower back.
transliteration: Yāo zhuī chuān cì huì cóng nín de xià bèi bù qǔ shǎo liàng yè tǐ yàng běn.
translation: 腰椎穿刺会从您的下背部取少量液体样本。

english: I will explain the benefits and risks before any procedure.
transliteration: Jìn xíng rèn hé cāo zuò qián, wǒ huì xiàng nín jiě shì hǎo chù hé fēng xiǎn.
translation: 进行任何操作前，我会向您解释好处和风险。

english: Do you have any questions before we proceed?
transliteration: Jì xù zhī qián, nín yǒu shén me wèn tí ma?
translation: 继续之前，您有什么问题吗？

english: We will discuss the results and next steps with you.
transliteration: Wǒ men huì hé nín tǎo lùn jiǎn chá jié guǒ hé jiē xià lái de ān pái.
translation: 我们会和您讨论检查结果和接下来的安排。

english: Please take your medicines exactly as prescribed.
transliteration: Qǐng yán gé àn zhào chǔ fāng fú yào.
translation: 请严格按照处方服药。

english: Do not stop seizure medicines suddenly without medical advice.
transliteration: Wèi jīng yī shēng jiàn yì, bú yào tū rán tíng yòng kàng diān xián yào.
translation: 未经医生建议，不要突然停用抗癫痫药。

english: Seek emergency care for sudden weakness, trouble speaking, or a severe sudden headache.
transliteration: Rú guǒ tū rán gǎn dào wú lì, shuō huà kùn nan huò tū rán jù liè tóu tòng, qǐng lì jí qù jí zhěn.
translation: 如果突然感到无力、说话困难或突然剧烈头痛，请立即去急诊。

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: Wǒ men huì wèi nín ān pái yí cì fù zhěn.
translation: 我们会为您安排一次复诊。

english: What questions do you have for me?
transliteration: Nín yǒu shén me wèn tí xiǎng wèn wǒ ma?
translation: 您有什么问题想问我吗？

english: Hello. I am here to examine your eyes.
transliteration: Nín hǎo, wǒ lái gěi nín jiǎn chá yǎn jing.
translation: 您好，我来给您检查眼睛。

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: Nín jīn tiān wèi shén me lái kàn zhěn?
translation: 您今天为什么来看诊？

english: Please sit here.
transliteration: Qǐng zuò zài zhè lǐ.
translation: 请坐在这里。

english: Which eye is bothering you?
transliteration: Nǎ zhī yǎn jing ràng nín bù shū fu?
translation: 哪只眼睛让您不舒服？

english: Is it one eye or both eyes?
transliteration: Shì yì zhī yǎn jing bù shū fu, hái shì liǎng zhī dōu bù shū fu?
translation: 是一只眼睛不舒服，还是两只都不舒服？

english: When did the problem start?
transliteration: Zhè ge wèn tí shì shén me shí hou kāi shǐ de?
translation: 这个问题是什么时候开始的？

english: May I examine your eyes?
transliteration: Wǒ kě yǐ jiǎn chá yí xià nín de yǎn jing ma?
translation: 我可以检查一下您的眼睛吗？

english: Please tell me if anything hurts.
transliteration: Rú guǒ yǒu rèn hé dì fang téng, qǐng gào su wǒ.
translation: 如果有任何地方疼，请告诉我。

english: How long has this been happening?
transliteration: Zhè zhǒng qíng kuàng chí xù duō jiǔ le?
translation: 这种情况持续多久了？

english: How many days has this been happening?
transliteration: Zhè zhǒng qíng kuàng chí xù jǐ tiān le?
translation: 这种情况持续几天了？

english: Did it start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: Zhè shì tū rán kāi shǐ de, hái shì màn màn chū xiàn de?
translation: 这是突然开始的，还是慢慢出现的？

english: Is it constant, or does it come and go?
transliteration: Zhè zhǒng qíng kuàng yì zhí dōu yǒu, hái shì shí yǒu shí wú?
translation: 这种情况一直都有，还是时有时无？

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: Měi cì fā zuò huì chí xù duō jiǔ?
translation: 每次发作会持续多久？

english: Does it last seconds, minutes, hours, or days?
transliteration: Měi cì chí xù jǐ miǎo, jǐ fēn zhōng, jǐ xiǎo shí, hái shì jǐ tiān?
translation: 每次持续几秒、几分钟、几小时，还是几天？

english: Is it getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: Qíng kuàng shì zài hǎo zhuǎn, biàn chà, hái shì méi yǒu biàn huà?
translation: 情况是在好转、变差，还是没有变化？

english: Has this happened before?
transliteration: Yǐ qián fā shēng guò zhè zhǒng qíng kuàng ma?
translation: 以前发生过这种情况吗？

english: Did you wake up with this problem?
transliteration: Nín xǐng lái shí jiù yǒu zhè ge wèn tí ma?
translation: 您醒来时就有这个问题吗？

english: Did it start after an injury or procedure?
transliteration: Zhè shì zài shòu shāng huò zuò wán mǒu zhǒng cāo zuò hòu kāi shǐ de ma?
translation: 这是在受伤或做完某种操作后开始的吗？

english: Has your vision changed?
transliteration: Nín de shì lì yǒu biàn huà ma?
translation: 您的视力有变化吗？

english: Is your vision blurry?
transliteration: Nín kàn dōng xi mó hu ma?
translation: 您看东西模糊吗？

english: Did you suddenly lose vision?
transliteration: Nín de shì lì yǒu méi yǒu tū rán sàng shī?
translation: 您的视力有没有突然丧失？
