english: Did your vision return to normal?
transliteration: Nín de shì lì huī fù zhèng cháng le ma?
translation: 您的视力恢复正常了吗？

english: Is your vision loss complete or partial?
transliteration: Nín de shì lì shì wán quán sàng shī hái shì bù fen sàng shī?
translation: 您的视力是完全丧失还是部分丧失？

english: Is the centre of your vision affected?
transliteration: Nín de zhōng xīn shì lì shòu yǐng xiǎng le ma?
translation: 您的中心视力受影响了吗？

english: Is your side vision affected?
transliteration: Nín de zhōu biān shì lì shòu yǐng xiǎng le ma?
translation: 您的周边视力受影响了吗？

english: Is the top or bottom part of your vision missing?
transliteration: Nín de shì yě shàng fāng huò xià fāng yǒu quē shī ma?
translation: 您的视野上方或下方有缺失吗？

english: Do you see flashes of light?
transliteration: Nín kàn dào shǎn guāng ma?
translation: 您看到闪光吗？

english: Do you see new floating spots or cobwebs?
transliteration: Nín kàn dào xīn chū xiàn de piāo dòng hēi diǎn huò zhī zhū wǎng zhuàng yǐng zi ma?
translation: 您看到新出现的飘动黑点或蜘蛛网状影子吗？

english: Do you see a curtain or shadow over your vision?
transliteration: Nín kàn dào xiàng lián zi huò yǐng zi yí yàng de dōng xi zhē zhù shì yě ma?
translation: 您看到像帘子或影子一样的东西遮住视野吗？

english: Do straight lines look bent or wavy?
transliteration: Zhí xiàn kàn qǐ lái shì wān qū huò bō làng xíng de ma?
translation: 直线看起来是弯曲或波浪形的吗？

english: Do you see two images of one object?
transliteration: Nín kàn yí ge dōng xi shí huì kàn dào liǎng ge yǐng xiàng ma?
translation: 您看一个东西时会看到两个影像吗？

english: Does the double vision go away when you close either eye?
transliteration: Bì shàng rèn yì yì zhī yǎn jing hòu, chóng yǐng huì xiāo shī ma?
translation: 闭上任意一只眼睛后，重影会消失吗？

english: Do you see halos around lights?
transliteration: Nín kàn dào dēng guāng zhōu wéi yǒu guāng quān ma?
translation: 您看到灯光周围有光圈吗？

english: Is it harder to see at night?
transliteration: Nín wǎn shàng kàn dōng xi gèng kùn nan ma?
translation: 您晚上看东西更困难吗？

english: Does bright light bother your eyes?
transliteration: Qiáng guāng huì ràng nín de yǎn jing bù shū fu ma?
translation: 强光会让您的眼睛不舒服吗？

english: Do your eyes hurt?
transliteration: Nín de yǎn jing téng ma?
translation: 您的眼睛疼吗？

english: Where exactly does it hurt? Please point.
transliteration: Jù tǐ shì nǎ lǐ téng? Qǐng zhǐ chū lái.
translation: 具体是哪里疼？请指出来。

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: Téng tòng yǒu duō yán zhòng? Qǐng àn líng dào shí dǎ fēn.
translation: 疼痛有多严重？请按零到十打分。

english: Is the pain sharp, dull, or burning?
transliteration: Téng tòng shì jiān ruì de, dùn tòng, hái shì zhuó tòng?
translation: 疼痛是尖锐的、钝痛，还是灼痛？

english: Does the pain worsen when you move your eyes?
transliteration: Zhuǎn dòng yǎn jing shí, téng tòng huì jiā zhòng ma?
translation: 转动眼睛时，疼痛会加重吗？

english: Do you have a headache or nausea?
transliteration: Nín tóu tòng huò ě xīn ma?
translation: 您头痛或恶心吗？

english: Are your eyes red?
transliteration: Nín de yǎn jing fā hóng ma?
translation: 您的眼睛发红吗？

english: Do your eyes itch?
transliteration: Nín de yǎn jing yǎng ma?
translation: 您的眼睛痒吗？

english: Do your eyes feel dry or gritty?
transliteration: Nín de yǎn jing gǎn jué gān sè huò yǒu shā lì gǎn ma?
translation: 您的眼睛感觉干涩或有沙粒感吗？

english: Are your eyes watering?
transliteration: Nín de yǎn jing liú lèi ma?
translation: 您的眼睛流泪吗？

english: Is there sticky discharge or pus?
transliteration: Yǎn jing yǒu nián chóu fēn mì wù huò nóng ma?
translation: 眼睛有黏稠分泌物或脓吗？

english: Are your eyelids swollen or drooping?
transliteration: Nín de yǎn pí zhǒng le huò xià chuí le ma?
translation: 您的眼皮肿了或下垂了吗？

english: Do you have pain around, above, or below the eye?
transliteration: Nín de yǎn jing zhōu wéi, shàng fāng huò xià fāng téng ma?
translation: 您的眼睛周围、上方或下方疼吗？

english: Did anything hit or scratch your eye?
transliteration: Yǒu dōng xi zhuàng dào huò huá shāng nín de yǎn jing ma?
translation: 有东西撞到或划伤您的眼睛吗？

english: Did something get into your eye?
transliteration: Yǒu dōng xi jìn dào nín de yǎn jing lǐ ma?
translation: 有东西进到您的眼睛里吗？

english: Did any chemical splash into your eye?
transliteration: Yǒu huà xué pǐn jiàn jìn nín de yǎn jing lǐ ma?
translation: 有化学品溅进您的眼睛里吗？

english: Have you rinsed your eye with water?
transliteration: Nín yòng shuǐ chōng xǐ guò yǎn jing ma?
translation: 您用水冲洗过眼睛吗？

english: Do you wear contact lenses?
transliteration: Nín dài yǐn xíng yǎn jìng ma?
translation: 您戴隐形眼镜吗？

english: Do you sleep while wearing contact lenses?
transliteration: Nín dài zhe yǐn xíng yǎn jìng shuì jiào ma?
translation: 您戴着隐形眼镜睡觉吗？

english: When did you last wear your contact lenses?
transliteration: Nín shàng yí cì dài yǐn xíng yǎn jìng shì shén me shí hou?
translation: 您上一次戴隐形眼镜是什么时候？

english: Do you swim or shower with contact lenses in?
transliteration: Nín dài zhe yǐn xíng yǎn jìng yóu yǒng huò lín yù ma?
translation: 您戴着隐形眼镜游泳或淋浴吗？

english: Have you recently started any new eye drops?
transliteration: Nín zuì jìn kāi shǐ shǐ yòng xīn de yǎn yào shuǐ le ma?
translation: 您最近开始使用新的眼药水了吗？

english: Do you wear glasses?
transliteration: Nín dài yǎnjìng ma?
translation: 您戴眼镜吗？

english: Have you recently changed your glasses prescription?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn huàn guò yǎnjìng dùshu ma?
translation: 您最近换过眼镜度数吗？

english: Have you had eye surgery or laser treatment?
transliteration: Nín zuò guò yǎnkē shǒushù huò jīguāng zhìliáo ma?
translation: 您做过眼科手术或激光治疗吗？

english: Have you ever had this eye condition before?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián dé guò zhè zhǒng yǎnbìng ma?
translation: 您以前得过这种眼病吗？

english: Have you been told you have glaucoma (kala motia)?
transliteration: Yǒu yīshēng gàosu guò nín huàn yǒu qīngguāngyǎn (kala motia) ma?
translation: 有医生告诉过您患有青光眼（kala motia）吗？

english: Have you been told you have cataracts (chitta motia)?
transliteration: Yǒu yīshēng gàosu guò nín huàn yǒu báinèizhàng (chitta motia) ma?
translation: 有医生告诉过您患有白内障（chitta motia）吗？

english: Does anyone in your family have glaucoma?
transliteration: Nín jiālǐ yǒu rén huàn yǒu qīngguāngyǎn ma?
translation: 您家里有人患有青光眼吗？

english: Do you have diabetes or high blood pressure?
transliteration: Nín yǒu tángniàobìng huò gāoxuèyā ma?
translation: 您有糖尿病或高血压吗？

english: What medications or eye drops do you use?
transliteration: Nín zài yòng nǎxiē yào huò yǎnyàoshuǐ?
translation: 您在用哪些药或眼药水？

english: Are you allergic to any medications?
transliteration: Nín duì shénme yào guòmǐn ma?
translation: 您对什么药过敏吗？

english: When was your last eye examination?
transliteration: Nín shàng yí cì zuò yǎnkē jiǎnchá shì shénme shíhou?
translation: 您上一次做眼科检查是什么时候？

english: Please show me which eye.
transliteration: Qǐng nín zhǐ gěi wǒ kàn shì nǎ zhī yǎnjing.
translation: 请您指给我看是哪只眼睛。

english: Look here.
transliteration: Kàn zhèlǐ.
translation: 看这里。

english: Look straight ahead.
transliteration: Yǎnjing kàn qiánfāng.
translation: 眼睛看前方。

english: Open your eyes.
transliteration: Qǐng zhēngkāi yǎnjing.
translation: 请睁开眼睛。

english: Close your eyes.
transliteration: Qǐng bì shàng yǎnjing.
translation: 请闭上眼睛。

english: Keep both eyes open.
transliteration: Qǐng zhēngkāi shuāngyǎn.
translation: 请睁开双眼。

english: Put your glasses on.
transliteration: Qǐng dài shàng yǎnjìng.
translation: 请戴上眼镜。

english: Please remove your glasses.
transliteration: Qǐng zhāi xià yǎnjìng.
translation: 请摘下眼镜。

english: Cover your left eye.
transliteration: Qǐng zhē zhù zuǒyǎn.
translation: 请遮住左眼。

english: Cover your right eye.
transliteration: Qǐng zhē zhù yòuyǎn.
translation: 请遮住右眼。

english: Read the smallest line you can see.
transliteration: Qǐng dú chū nín néng kànqīng de zuì xiǎo yì háng.
translation: 请读出您能看清的最小一行。

english: Look through this small hole.
transliteration: Qǐng tōngguò zhège xiǎo kǒng kàn.
translation: 请通过这个小孔看。

english: How many fingers do you see?
transliteration: Nín néng kàn dào jǐ gēn shǒuzhǐ?
translation: 您能看到几根手指？

english: Can you see my hand moving?
transliteration: Nín néng kàn dào wǒ de shǒu zài dòng ma?
translation: 您能看到我的手在动吗？

english: Can you see the light?
transliteration: Nín néng kàn dào guāng ma?
translation: 您能看到光吗？

english: I am going to shine a light into your eyes.
transliteration: Wǒ yào yòng guāng zhào yíxià nín de yǎnjing.
translation: 我要用光照一下您的眼睛。

english: Please look at the wall behind me.
transliteration: Qǐng kàn wǒ shēnhòu de qiáng.
translation: 请看我身后的墙。

english: Do not look directly at the light.
transliteration: Qǐng bú yào zhíshì guāngyuán.
translation: 请不要直视光源。

english: Look at my finger without moving your head.
transliteration: Tóu bú yào dòng, zhǐ kànzhe wǒ de shǒuzhǐ.
translation: 头不要动，只看着我的手指。

english: Look up.
transliteration: Xiàng shàng kàn.
translation: 向上看。

english: Look down.
transliteration: Xiàng xià kàn.
translation: 向下看。

english: Look left.
transliteration: Xiàng zuǒ kàn.
translation: 向左看。

english: Look right.
transliteration: Xiàng yòu kàn.
translation: 向右看。

english: Is the double vision worse in this direction?
transliteration: Kàn zhège fāngxiàng shí, chóngyǐng huì gèng yánzhòng ma?
translation: 看这个方向时，重影会更严重吗？

english: Raise your eyebrows.
transliteration: Qǐng tái méimao.
translation: 请抬眉毛。

english: Keep looking at my nose, not my hand.
transliteration: Qǐng yìzhí kànzhe wǒ de bízi, bú yào kàn wǒ de shǒu.
translation: 请一直看着我的鼻子，不要看我的手。

english: Raise your hand when you see my fingers.
transliteration: Kàn dào wǒ de shǒuzhǐ shí, qǐng jǔ shǒu.
translation: 看到我的手指时，请举手。

english: Tell me when you see the light.
transliteration: Kàn dào guāng shí qǐng gàosu wǒ.
translation: 看到光时请告诉我。

english: Do you see the same on both sides?
transliteration: Liǎng biān kàn dào de yíyàng ma?
translation: 两边看到的一样吗？

english: I am going to check the pressure in your eye.
transliteration: Wǒ yào jiǎnchá yíxià nín yǎnjing de yālì.
translation: 我要检查一下您眼睛的压力。

english: You may feel a light touch on your eye.
transliteration: Nín kěnéng huì gǎnjué dào yǎnjing bèi qīngqīng pèng le yíxià.
translation: 您可能会感觉到眼睛被轻轻碰了一下。

english: Please keep still and try not to blink.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎochí bú dòng, jǐnliàng bú yào zhǎyǎn.
translation: 请保持不动，尽量不要眨眼。

english: Place your chin here and your forehead against the bar.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ xiàba fàng zài zhèlǐ, étóu dǐ zhù hénggān.
translation: 请把下巴放在这里，额头抵住横杆。

english: Open your eyes wide.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ yǎnjing zhēng dà.
translation: 请把眼睛睁大。

english: Please do not pull your head back.
transliteration: Qǐng bú yào bǎ tóu wǎng hòu suō.
translation: 请不要把头往后缩。

english: The light will be bright.
transliteration: Dēngguāng huì hěn liàng.
translation: 灯光会很亮。

english: I am going to touch your eyelid.
transliteration: Wǒ yào pèng yíxià nín de yǎnpí.
translation: 我要碰一下您的眼皮。

english: Look at my ear.
transliteration: Qǐng kàn wǒ de ěrduo.
translation: 请看我的耳朵。

english: I am going to put drops in your eyes.
transliteration: Wǒ yào gěi nín de yǎnjing dī yǎnyàoshuǐ.
translation: 我要给您的眼睛滴眼药水。

english: These drops will numb your eye and may sting briefly.
transliteration: Zhè zhǒng yǎnyàoshuǐ huì ràng nín de yǎnjing zànshí shīqù gǎnjué, kěnéng huì duǎnzàn cìtòng.
translation: 这种眼药水会让您的眼睛暂时失去感觉，可能会短暂刺痛。

english: These drops will make your pupils bigger.
transliteration: Zhè zhǒng yǎnyàoshuǐ huì ràng nín de tóngkǒng biàn dà.
translation: 这种眼药水会让您的瞳孔变大。

english: Your vision may be blurry for several hours.
transliteration: Nín de shìlì kěnéng huì móhu jǐ ge xiǎoshí.
translation: 您的视力可能会模糊几个小时。

english: Bright light may bother you after the drops.
transliteration: Dī yào hòu, qiángguāng kěnéng huì ràng nín juéde bù shūfu.
translation: 滴药后，强光可能会让您觉得不舒服。

english: Please do not rub your eyes.
transliteration: Qǐng bú yào róu yǎnjing.
translation: 请不要揉眼睛。

english: Please remove your contact lenses.
transliteration: Qǐng zhāi xià yǐnxíng yǎnjìng.
translation: 请摘下隐形眼镜。

english: We are going to take photographs of the back of your eye.
transliteration: Wǒmen yào gěi nín yǎnjing hòubù pāizhào.
translation: 我们要给您眼睛后部拍照。

english: We are going to do a scan of the back of your eye.
transliteration: Wǒmen yào gěi nín yǎnjing hòubù zuò sǎomiáo jiǎnchá.
translation: 我们要给您眼睛后部做扫描检查。

english: Have you had an eye ultrasound before?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián zuò guò yǎnbù chāoshēng jiǎnchá ma?
translation: 您以前做过眼部超声检查吗？

english: Have you had an MRI scan of your eyes or head?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián zuò guò yǎnjing huò tóubù de cígòngzhèn (MRI) jiǎnchá ma?
translation: 您以前做过眼睛或头部的磁共振（MRI）检查吗？

english: You will lie still inside a noisy scanner.
transliteration: Nín yào tǎng zài yì tái huì fāchū zàoshēng de sǎomiáoyí lǐ, bǎochí bú dòng.
translation: 您要躺在一台会发出噪声的扫描仪里，保持不动。

english: Please follow the light with your eyes.
transliteration: Qǐng yòng yǎnjing gēnzhe dēngguāng kàn.
translation: 请用眼睛跟着灯光看。

english: The examination is finished. Thank you.
transliteration: Jiǎnchá jiéshù le, xièxie nín.
translation: 检查结束了，谢谢您。

english: We need to arrange an appointment with an eye specialist.
transliteration: Wǒmen xūyào wèi nín ānpái yí cì yǎnkē zhuānkē yīshēng de yùyuē.
translation: 我们需要为您安排一次眼科专科医生的预约。

english: I need to discuss your examination with another doctor.
transliteration: Wǒ xūyào hé lìng yí wèi yīshēng tǎolùn nín de jiǎnchá jiéguǒ.
translation: 我需要和另一位医生讨论您的检查结果。

english: We will use a professional interpreter to explain your results.
transliteration: Wǒmen huì qǐng zhuānyè kǒuyìyuán wèi nín jiěshì jiǎnchá jiéguǒ.
translation: 我们会请专业口译员为您解释检查结果。

english: If your vision suddenly worsens, seek urgent medical care.
transliteration: Rúguǒ nín de shìlì tūrán biàn chà, qǐng jǐnkuài jiùyī.
translation: 如果您的视力突然变差，请尽快就医。

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: Nín yǒu shénme wèntí ma?
translation: 您有什么问题吗？

english: Hello, I am here to examine your ears, nose and throat.
transliteration: Nín hǎo, wǒ lái wèi nín jiǎnchá ěrduo, bízi hé hóulóng.
translation: 您好，我来为您检查耳朵、鼻子和喉咙。

english: What problem brought you here today?
transliteration: Nín jīntiān shì yīnwèi shénme wèntí lái kànzhěn de?
translation: 您今天是因为什么问题来看诊的？

english: Please point to where you feel the problem.
transliteration: Qǐng zhǐchū nín juéde yǒu wèntí de dìfang.
translation: 请指出您觉得有问题的地方。

english: Is it on the right, left, or both sides?
transliteration: Shì zài yòubiān, zuǒbiān, háishi liǎngbiān dōu yǒu?
translation: 是在右边、左边，还是两边都有？

english: When did this start?
transliteration: Zhè shì cóng shénme shíhou kāishǐ de?
translation: 这是从什么时候开始的？

english: Did it start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: Zhè shì tūrán kāishǐ de, háishi mànmàn chūxiàn de?
translation: 这是突然开始的，还是慢慢出现的？

english: How long has it been happening: hours, days, weeks, or months?
transliteration: Zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng chíxù duōjiǔ le: jǐ xiǎoshí, jǐ tiān, jǐ zhōu háishi jǐ ge yuè?
translation: 这种情况持续多久了：几小时、几天、几周还是几个月？

english: Is it getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: Qíngkuàng shì zài hǎozhuǎn, jiāzhòng, háishi méiyǒu biànhuà?
translation: 情况是在好转、加重，还是没有变化？

english: Have you had this problem before?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián yǒu guo zhège wèntí ma?
translation: 您以前有过这个问题吗？

english: Are you having trouble breathing or swallowing your saliva?
transliteration: Nín hūxī huò tūnyàn kǒushuǐ yǒu kùnnan ma?
translation: 您呼吸或吞咽口水有困难吗？

english: Are you having trouble hearing?
transliteration: Nín tīng dōngxi yǒu kùnnan ma?
translation: 您听东西有困难吗？

english: Which ear is affected?
transliteration: Nǎ zhī ěrduo yǒu wèntí?
translation: 哪只耳朵有问题？

english: Did your hearing change suddenly?
transliteration: Nín de tīnglì shì tūrán fāshēng biànhuà de ma?
translation: 您的听力是突然发生变化的吗？

english: When was your hearing last normal?
transliteration: Nín shàng yí cì tīnglì zhèngcháng shì shénme shíhou?
translation: 您上一次听力正常是什么时候？

english: Is your hearing loss constant or does it come and go?
transliteration: Nín de tīnglì xiàjiàng shì yìzhí rúcǐ, háishi shí hǎo shí huài?
translation: 您的听力下降是一直如此，还是时好时坏？

english: Do you have trouble understanding speech, especially in noisy places?
transliteration: Nín tīng biérén shuōhuà shí huì juéde kùnnan ma? Yóuqí shì zài cáozá de dìfang?
translation: 您听别人说话时会觉得困难吗？尤其是在嘈杂的地方？

english: Do you use hearing aids?
transliteration: Nín dài zhùtīngqì ma?
translation: 您戴助听器吗？

english: Have you had a hearing test before?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián zuòguo tīnglì jiǎnchá ma?
translation: 您以前做过听力检查吗？

english: Have you been exposed to loud noise recently or at work?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn huò gōngzuò shí jiēchùguo hěn dà de zàoshēng ma?
translation: 您最近或工作时接触过很大的噪声吗？

english: Do you hear ringing, buzzing, or other sounds in your ears?
transliteration: Nín ěrduo li huì tīngdào wēngwēng shēng, língshēng huò qítā shēngyīn ma?
translation: 您耳朵里会听到嗡嗡声、铃声或其他声音吗？

english: Is the sound in one ear or both ears?
transliteration: Shì yì zhī ěrduo háishi liǎng zhī ěrduo dōu yǒu zhè zhǒng shēngyīn?
translation: 是一只耳朵还是两只耳朵都有这种声音？

english: Is the sound constant or intermittent?
transliteration: Zhè zhǒng shēngyīn shì yìzhí dōu yǒu, háishi shí yǒu shí wú?
translation: 这种声音是一直都有，还是时有时无？

english: Does the sound beat in time with your heartbeat?
transliteration: Zhè zhǒng shēngyīn huì gēnzhe nín de xīntiào yìqǐ tiàodòng ma?
translation: 这种声音会跟着您的心跳一起跳动吗？

english: Does the sound affect your sleep or daily activities?
transliteration: Zhè zhǒng shēngyīn huì yǐngxiǎng nín de shuìmián huò rìcháng huódòng ma?
translation: 这种声音会影响您的睡眠或日常活动吗？

english: Does your ear feel blocked or under pressure?
transliteration: Nín juéde ěrduo dǔzhù le huò yǒu yālì ma?
translation: 您觉得耳朵堵住了或有压力吗？

english: Does swallowing or yawning change the pressure?
transliteration: Tūnyàn huò dǎ hāqian huì gǎibiàn zhè zhǒng yālìgǎn ma?
translation: 吞咽或打哈欠会改变这种压力感吗？

english: Do you have ear pain?
transliteration: Nín ěrduo téng ma?
translation: 您耳朵疼吗？

english: Does it hurt when you touch or pull your outer ear?
transliteration: Mō huò lā wài'ěr shí huì téng ma?
translation: 摸或拉外耳时会疼吗？

english: Is fluid or pus coming out of your ear?
transliteration: Nín de ěrduo yǒu yètǐ huò nóng liú chūlái ma?
translation: 您的耳朵有液体或脓流出来吗？

english: What colour is the discharge?
transliteration: Liú chūlái de dōngxi shì shénme yánsè?
translation: 流出来的东西是什么颜色？

english: Have you noticed blood coming from your ear?
transliteration: Nín fāxiàn ěrduo liúxuè le ma?
translation: 您发现耳朵流血了吗？

english: Do you have fever or swelling behind your ear?
transliteration: Nín fāshāo le ma? Ěrduo hòumian zhǒng le ma?
translation: 您发烧了吗？耳朵后面肿了吗？

english: Have you recently been swimming or gotten water in your ear?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn yóuguo yǒng, huòzhě ěrduo jìn guo shuǐ ma?
translation: 您最近游过泳，或者耳朵进过水吗？

english: Do you use cotton swabs to clean your ears?
transliteration: Nín huì yòng miánqiān qīngjié ěrduo ma?
translation: 您会用棉签清洁耳朵吗？

english: Did anything get stuck in your ear?
transliteration: Yǒu dōngxi kǎ zài nín ěrduo li le ma?
translation: 有东西卡在您耳朵里了吗？

english: Have you had an injury or blow to your ear or head?
transliteration: Nín de ěrduo huò tóubù zuìjìn shòuguo shāng huò bèi zhuàngguo ma?
translation: 您的耳朵或头部最近受过伤或被撞过吗？

english: Do you feel dizzy or unsteady?
transliteration: Nín juéde tóuyūn huò zhàn bù wěn ma?
translation: 您觉得头晕或站不稳吗？

english: Does it feel as though you or the room is spinning?
transliteration: Nín juéde zìjǐ huò fángjiān hǎoxiàng zài xuánzhuǎn ma?
translation: 您觉得自己或房间好像在旋转吗？

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: Měi cì fāzuò huì chíxù duōjiǔ?
translation: 每次发作会持续多久？

english: Does turning your head or rolling over in bed trigger it?
transliteration: Zhuǎn tóu huò zài chuáng shàng fānshēn huì yǐnfā zhè zhǒng gǎnjué ma?
translation: 转头或在床上翻身会引发这种感觉吗？

english: Do you have nausea or vomiting with the dizziness?
transliteration: Tóuyūn shí nín huì ěxīn huò ǒutù ma?
translation: 头晕时您会恶心或呕吐吗？

english: Do you also notice hearing loss, ringing, or ear fullness?
transliteration: Nín hái huì juéde tīnglì xiàjiàng, ěrmíng huò ěrduo fāmēn ma?
translation: 您还会觉得听力下降、耳鸣或耳朵发闷吗？

english: Have you fainted, had weakness, double vision, or trouble speaking?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu yūndǎo, wúlì, kàn dōngxi chóngyǐng huò shuōhuà kùnnan?
translation: 您有没有晕倒、无力、看东西重影或说话困难？

english: Is your nose blocked or stuffy?
transliteration: Nín de bízi dǔzhù le ma?
translation: 您的鼻子堵住了吗？

english: Is one nostril blocked or both?
transliteration: Shì yí ge bíkǒng dǔzhù le, háishi liǎng ge dōu dǔzhù le?
translation: 是一个鼻孔堵住了，还是两个都堵住了？

english: Do you have a runny nose?
transliteration: Nín liú bítì ma?
translation: 您流鼻涕吗？

english: What colour is the mucus?
transliteration: Bítì shì shénme yánsè?
translation: 鼻涕是什么颜色？

english: Do you have pain or pressure in your cheeks or forehead?
transliteration: Nín de liǎnjiá huò étóu téng, huòzhě yǒu yāpògǎn ma?
translation: 您的脸颊或额头疼，或者有压迫感吗？

english: Does mucus drip down the back of your throat?
transliteration: Bítì huì liú dào hóulóng hòumian ma?
translation: 鼻涕会流到喉咙后面吗？

english: Have you lost or noticed a change in your sense of smell?
transliteration: Nín de xiùjué jiǎntuì le, huòzhě yǒu shénme biànhuà ma?
translation: 您的嗅觉减退了，或者有什么变化吗？

english: Do you sneeze or have itchy, watery eyes?
transliteration: Nín huì dǎ pēntì, huòzhě yǎnjing fāyǎng, liúlèi ma?
translation: 您会打喷嚏，或者眼睛发痒、流泪吗？

english: Do you get sinus infections repeatedly?
transliteration: Nín huì fǎnfù dé bídòu gǎnrǎn ma?
translation: 您会反复得鼻窦感染吗？

english: Have you had a recent cold or allergy symptoms?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn gǎnmào guo, huòzhě yǒu guòmǐn zhèngzhuàng ma?
translation: 您最近感冒过，或者有过敏症状吗？

english: Have you had a nosebleed?
transliteration: Nín liúguo bíxuè ma?
translation: 您流过鼻血吗？

english: Which nostril is bleeding?
transliteration: Nǎ ge bíkǒng zài liúxuè?
translation: 哪个鼻孔在流血？

english: How long does the bleeding usually last?
transliteration: Tōngcháng huì liú duōjiǔ?
translation: 通常会流多久？

english: Is the bleeding heavy or difficult to stop?
transliteration: Chūxuèliàng dà ma? Huòzhě hěn nán zhǐzhù ma?
translation: 出血量大吗？或者很难止住吗？

english: Have you injured your nose recently?
transliteration: Nín de bízi zuìjìn shòuguo shāng ma?
translation: 您的鼻子最近受过伤吗？

english: Are you taking blood thinners?
transliteration: Nín zài fúyòng kàngníngxuè yào ma?
translation: 您在服用抗凝血药吗？

english: Do you pick your nose or use nasal sprays?
transliteration: Nín huì wā bízi huò shǐyòng bí pēnjì ma?
translation: 您会挖鼻子或使用鼻喷剂吗？

english: Do you have a sore throat?
transliteration: Nín hóulóng tòng ma?
translation: 您喉咙痛吗？

english: Is swallowing painful?
transliteration: Tūnyàn shí huì téng ma?
translation: 吞咽时会疼吗？

english: Is it difficult to swallow solids, liquids, or both?
transliteration: Tūnyàn gùtǐ shíwù, yètǐ, háishi liǎng zhě dōu kùnnan?
translation: 吞咽固体食物、液体，还是两者都困难？

english: Does food feel stuck in your throat?
transliteration: Nín juéde shíwù kǎ zài hóulóng li le ma?
translation: 您觉得食物卡在喉咙里了吗？

english: Do you cough or choke when eating or drinking?
transliteration: Nín chī dōngxi huò hē shuǐ shí huì késou huò qiàngdào ma?
translation: 您吃东西或喝水时会咳嗽或呛到吗？

english: Can you swallow your saliva?
transliteration: Nín néng yànxià zìjǐ de kǒushuǐ ma?
translation: 您能咽下自己的口水吗？

english: Do you have fever, swollen tonsils, or white patches in your throat?
transliteration: Nín fāshāo le ma? Biǎntáotǐ zhǒng le ma? Hóulóng li yǒu báidiǎn ma?
translation: 您发烧了吗？扁桃体肿了吗？喉咙里有白点吗？

english: Have you had repeated tonsil infections?
transliteration: Nín fǎnfù déguo biǎntáotǐ gǎnrǎn ma?
translation: 您反复得过扁桃体感染吗？

english: Do you feel a lump or something stuck in your throat?
transliteration: Nín juéde hóulóng li yǒu zhǒngkuài huò yǒu dōngxi kǎzhe ma?
translation: 您觉得喉咙里有肿块或有东西卡着吗？

english: Has your voice become hoarse or changed?
transliteration: Nín de shēngyīn biàn de sīyǎ huò fāshēng biànhuà le ma?
translation: 您的声音变得嘶哑或发生变化了吗？

english: How long has your voice been different?
transliteration: Nín de shēngyīn zhèyàng yǒu duōjiǔ le?
translation: 您的声音这样有多久了？

english: Have you completely lost your voice?
transliteration: Nín wánquán shīshēng le ma?
translation: 您完全失声了吗？

english: Do you have noisy breathing or difficulty breathing?
transliteration: Nín hūxī shí yǒu záyīn huò hūxī kùnnan ma?
translation: 您呼吸时有杂音或呼吸困难吗？

english: Do you snore loudly?
transliteration: Nín dǎhān shēngyīn hěn dà ma?
translation: 您打鼾声音很大吗？

english: Has anyone noticed you stop breathing during sleep?
transliteration: Yǒu rén zhùyì dào nín shuìjiào shí huì tíngzhǐ hūxī ma?
translation: 有人注意到您睡觉时会停止呼吸吗？

english: Do you feel sleepy during the day?
transliteration: Nín báitiān huì juéde kùn ma?
translation: 您白天会觉得困吗？

english: Do you have persistent cough or acid reflux?
transliteration: Nín yǒu chíxù késou huò wèisuān fǎnliú ma?
translation: 您有持续咳嗽或胃酸反流吗？

english: Do you have pain or sores in your mouth?
transliteration: Nín de zuǐ li téng huò yǒu kuìyáng ma?
translation: 您的嘴里疼或有溃疡吗？

english: Do you have white or red patches in your mouth?
transliteration: Nín zuǐ li yǒu báisè huò hóngsè de bānkuài ma?
translation: 您嘴里有白色或红色的斑块吗？

english: Do you have trouble opening your mouth?
transliteration: Nín zhāngzuǐ kùnnan ma?
translation: 您张嘴困难吗？

english: Do you have jaw pain or pain in front of your ear?
transliteration: Nín xiàba téng, huòzhě ěrduo qiánmian téng ma?
translation: 您下巴疼，或者耳朵前面疼吗？

english: Does your jaw click or lock?
transliteration: Nín de xiàba huì fāchū kādā shēng huò kǎzhù ma?
translation: 您的下巴会发出咔哒声或卡住吗？

english: Does your mouth feel unusually dry?
transliteration: Nín de zuǐba bǐ píngshí gān ma?
translation: 您的嘴巴比平时干吗？

english: Do you have swelling under your jaw or near your ear?
transliteration: Nín de xiàba xiàmian huò ěrduo fùjìn zhǒng le ma?
translation: 您的下巴下面或耳朵附近肿了吗？

english: Does the swelling or pain worsen when you eat?
transliteration: Chī dōngxi shí zhǒngzhàng huò téngtòng huì jiāzhòng ma?
translation: 吃东西时肿胀或疼痛会加重吗？

english: Have you noticed a change in your sense of taste?
transliteration: Nín fāxiàn zìjǐ de wèijué yǒu biànhuà ma?
translation: 您发现自己的味觉有变化吗？

english: Have you noticed a lump or swelling in your neck?
transliteration: Nín de bózi shàng yǒu zhǒngkuài huò zhǒngzhàng ma?
translation: 您的脖子上有肿块或肿胀吗？

english: How long has the lump been there?
transliteration: Zhège zhǒngkuài yǒu duōjiǔ le?
translation: 这个肿块有多久了？

english: Is the lump growing or painful?
transliteration: Zhège zhǒngkuài zài biàn dà huò huì téng ma?
translation: 这个肿块在变大或会疼吗？

english: Have you had unexplained weight loss or night sweats?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu bùmíng yuányīn de tǐzhòng xiàjiàng huò yèjiān dàohàn?
translation: 您有没有不明原因地体重下降或夜间盗汗？

english: Do you have persistent one-sided throat or ear pain?
transliteration: Nín yí cè de hóulóng huò ěrduo yìzhí téng ma?
translation: 您一侧的喉咙或耳朵一直疼吗？

english: Have you coughed up blood?
transliteration: Nín kés chūguo xuè ma?
translation: 您咳出过血吗？

english: Do you smoke, vape, or use chewing tobacco?
transliteration: Nín chōuyān, xī diànzǐyān huò jiáo yāncǎo ma?
translation: 您抽烟、吸电子烟或嚼烟草吗？

english: Do you drink alcohol?
transliteration: Nín hējiǔ ma?
translation: 您喝酒吗？

english: Have you had ear, nose, or throat surgery?
transliteration: Nín zuòguo ěr, bí huò hóulóng shǒushù ma?
translation: 您做过耳、鼻或喉咙手术吗？

english: Have you had ear infections or a perforated eardrum before?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián déguo ěrduo gǎnrǎn huò gǔmó chuānkǒng ma?
translation: 您以前得过耳朵感染或鼓膜穿孔吗？

english: Have you had your tonsils or adenoids removed?
transliteration: Nín de biǎntáotǐ huò xiànyàngtǐ qiēchú guo ma?
translation: 您的扁桃体或腺样体切除过吗？

english: Have you had a CT scan, MRI, or hearing test?
transliteration: Nín zuòguo CT, MRI huò tīnglì jiǎnchá ma?
translation: 您做过 CT、MRI 或听力检查吗？

english: What medications, drops, or sprays have you tried?
transliteration: Nín shìguo nǎxiē yàowù, dījì huò pēnjì?
translation: 您试过哪些药物、滴剂或喷剂？

english: How often and for how long have you used them?
transliteration: Nín yòng le duōjiǔ? Duō cháng shíjiān yòng yí cì?
translation: 您用了多久？多长时间用一次？

english: Did the treatment help?
transliteration: Zhìliáo yǒu bāngzhù ma?
translation: 治疗有帮助吗？

english: Are you allergic to any medications?
transliteration: Nín duì shénme yàowù guòmǐn ma?
translation: 您对什么药物过敏吗？

english: Is there a family history of hearing loss or head and neck cancer?
transliteration: Nín de jiārén yǒu tīnglì xiàjiàng huò tóujǐngbù áizhèng bìngshǐ ma?
translation: 您的家人有听力下降或头颈部癌症病史吗？

english: Please sit still. I am going to look inside your ear.
transliteration: Qǐng zuò hǎo bié dòng. Wǒ yào kànkan nín de ěrduo lǐmian.
translation: 请坐好别动。我要看看您的耳朵里面。

english: Please remove your hearing aid.
transliteration: Qǐng qǔxià zhùtīngqì.
translation: 请取下助听器。

english: I will gently pull your ear to see inside.
transliteration: Wǒ huì qīngqīng lā yíxià nín de ěrduo, kànkan lǐmian.
translation: 我会轻轻拉一下您的耳朵，看看里面。

english: Tell me if this hurts.
transliteration: Rúguǒ zhèlǐ téng, qǐng gàosu wǒ.
translation: 如果这里疼，请告诉我。

english: I am going to check your hearing.
transliteration: Wǒ yào jiǎnchá yíxià nín de tīnglì.
translation: 我要检查一下您的听力。

english: Cover one ear and repeat the words you hear.
transliteration: Wǔzhù yì zhī ěrduo, ránhòu chóngfù nín tīngdào de cí.
translation: 捂住一只耳朵，然后重复您听到的词。

english: Tell me whether you hear the tuning fork on the left, right, or in the middle.
transliteration: Qǐng gàosu wǒ, nín tīngdào yīnchā de shēngyīn shì zài zuǒbian, yòubian, háishi zhèng zhōngjiān.
translation: 请告诉我，您听到音叉的声音是在左边、右边，还是正中间。

english: Tell me when you can no longer hear the sound.
transliteration: Tīng bú dào shēngyīn shí qǐng gàosu wǒ.
translation: 听不到声音时请告诉我。

english: I am going to examine your eardrum.
transliteration: Wǒ yào jiǎnchá yíxià nín de ěrmó.
translation: 我要检查一下您的耳膜。

english: I am going to examine your nose.
transliteration: Wǒ yào jiǎnchá yíxià nín de bízi.
translation: 我要检查一下您的鼻子。

english: Please breathe through your nose.
transliteration: Qǐng yòng bízi hūxī.
translation: 请用鼻子呼吸。

english: Close one nostril and breathe through the other.
transliteration: Qǐng ànzhù yí cè bíkǒng, yòng lìng yí cè hūxī.
translation: 请按住一侧鼻孔，用另一侧呼吸。

english: Open your mouth wide, please.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ zuǐ zhāng dà.
translation: 请把嘴张大。

english: Stick out your tongue, please.
transliteration: Qǐng shēnchū shétou.
translation: 请伸出舌头。

english: Say “ah,” please.
transliteration: Qǐng shuō “ā”。
translation: 请说“啊”。

english: Move your tongue from side to side.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ shétou zuǒyòu yídòng.
translation: 请把舌头左右移动。

english: I am going to feel your neck for any lumps.
transliteration: Wǒ yào mōmo nín de bózi, kànkan yǒu méiyǒu zhǒngkuài.
translation: 我要摸摸您的脖子，看看有没有肿块。

english: Please swallow once.
transliteration: Qǐng tūnyàn yí cì.
translation: 请吞咽一次。

english: Turn your head to the left, then to the right.
transliteration: Qǐng xiān bǎ tóu zhuǎnxiàng zuǒbian, zài zhuǎnxiàng yòubian.
translation: 请先把头转向左边，再转向右边。

english: We may need a formal hearing test.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng xūyào wèi nín zuò yí cì zhèngshì de tīnglì jiǎnchá.
translation: 我们可能需要为您做一次正式的听力检查。

english: We may need a camera examination of your nose or throat.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng xūyào yòng shèxiàngtóu jiǎnchá nín de bízi huò hóulóng.
translation: 我们可能需要用摄像头检查您的鼻子或喉咙。

english: I will gently pass a small flexible camera through your nose.
transliteration: Wǒ huì qīngqīng de bǎ yì gēn xiǎoxíng ruǎnguǎn shèxiàngtóu cóng nín de bízi shēn jìnqù.
translation: 我会轻轻地把一根小型软管摄像头从您的鼻子伸进去。

english: You may feel pressure or discomfort, but tell me if it is painful.
transliteration: Nín kěnéng huì gǎndào yǒu yālì huò bù shūfu; rúguǒ juéde téng, qǐng gàosu wǒ.
translation: 您可能会感到有压力或不舒服；如果觉得疼，请告诉我。

english: We may need a CT scan or MRI to look more closely.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng xūyào zuò CT sǎomiáo huò MRI, yǐbiàn kàn de gèng qīngchu.
translation: 我们可能需要做CT扫描或MRI，以便看得更清楚。

english: We may need to take a small sample of tissue for testing.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng xūyào qǔ yì xiǎo kuài zǔzhī zuò jiǎnchá.
translation: 我们可能需要取一小块组织做检查。

english: I am going to remove some earwax if it is safe to do so.
transliteration: Rúguǒ ānquán de huà, wǒ huì bāng nín qīngchú yìxiē ěrgòu.
translation: 如果安全的话，我会帮您清除一些耳垢。

english: Please use the medicine exactly as prescribed.
transliteration: Qǐng yángé ànzhào chǔfāng shǐyòng yàowù.
translation: 请严格按照处方使用药物。

english: I will prescribe ear drops or a nasal spray if needed.
transliteration: Rúguǒ xūyào, wǒ huì gěi nín kāi ěr yàoshuǐ huò bí pēnjì.
translation: 如果需要，我会给您开耳药水或鼻喷剂。

english: Keep your ear dry until we tell you otherwise.
transliteration: Zài wǒmen lìngxíng tōngzhī nín zhīqián, qǐng bǎochí ěrduo gānzào.
translation: 在我们另行通知您之前，请保持耳朵干燥。

english: Do not put cotton swabs or other objects inside your ear.
transliteration: Qǐng bú yào bǎ miánqiān huò qítā dōngxi fàng jìn ěrduo lǐ.
translation: 请不要把棉签或其他东西放进耳朵里。

english: If you have sudden hearing loss, seek urgent medical care.
transliteration: Rúguǒ nín tūrán tīng bú jiàn le, qǐng lìjí jiùyī.
translation: 如果您突然听不见了，请立即就医。

english: If you have severe trouble breathing or cannot swallow saliva, seek emergency care.
transliteration: Rúguǒ nín hūxī fēicháng kùnnán, huò wúfǎ tūnyàn kǒushuǐ, qǐng lìjí qù jízhěn.
translation: 如果您呼吸非常困难，或无法吞咽口水，请立即去急诊。

english: We will arrange an appointment with an ENT specialist.
transliteration: Wǒmen huì wèi nín ānpái ěrbíhóu zhuānkē yīshēng de yùyuē.
translation: 我们会为您安排耳鼻喉专科医生的预约。

english: We will use a professional interpreter to discuss results and treatment.
transliteration: Wǒmen huì qǐng zhuānyè kǒuyìyuán xiézhù tǎolùn jiǎnchá jiéguǒ hé zhìliáo fāng'àn.
translation: 我们会请专业口译员协助讨论检查结果和治疗方案。

english: The examination is finished. Thank you.
transliteration: Jiǎnchá jiéshù le. Xièxie nín.
translation: 检查结束了。谢谢您。

english: I am going to examine your skin.
transliteration: Wǒ yào jiǎnchá yíxià nín de pífū.
translation: 我要检查一下您的皮肤。

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: Nín jīntiān lái kànbìng shì yīn wèishénme?
translation: 您今天来看病是因为什么？

english: Please show me the affected area.
transliteration: Qǐng nín zhǐ gěi wǒ kàn shòu yǐngxiǎng de bùwèi.
translation: 请您指给我看受影响的部位。

english: May I examine this area?
transliteration: Wǒ kěyǐ jiǎnchá yíxià zhège bùwèi ma?
translation: 我可以检查一下这个部位吗？

english: Is it okay if I take a photograph for your medical record?
transliteration: Wǒ kěyǐ wèi nín de bìnglì pāi yì zhāng zhàopiàn ma?
translation: 我可以为您的病历拍一张照片吗？

english: When did you first notice this skin problem?
transliteration: Nín dì yī cì zhùyì dào zhège pífū wèntí shì shénme shíhou?
translation: 您第一次注意到这个皮肤问题是什么时候？

english: How long have you had it?
transliteration: Zhège wèntí chíxù duōjiǔ le?
translation: 这个问题持续多久了？

english: Did it appear suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: Tā shì tūrán chūxiàn de, háishi mànmàn chūxiàn de?
translation: 它是突然出现的，还是慢慢出现的？

english: Where did it first appear?
transliteration: Tā zuìxiān chūxiàn zài nǎlǐ?
translation: 它最先出现在哪里？

english: Has it spread to other areas?
transliteration: Tā kuòsàn dào qítā bùwèi le ma?
translation: 它扩散到其他部位了吗？

english: Is it getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: Tā shì zài hǎozhuǎn, biàn yánzhòng, háishi méiyǒu biànhuà?
translation: 它是在好转、变严重，还是没有变化？

english: Does it come and go or stay all the time?
transliteration: Tā shì shí yǒu shí wú, háishi yìzhí dōu zài?
translation: 它是时有时无，还是一直都在？

english: Have you had this before?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián yě yǒu guò zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng ma?
translation: 您以前也有过这种情况吗？

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: Měi cì fāzuò huì chíxù duōjiǔ?
translation: 每次发作会持续多久？

english: Is it happening more often now?
transliteration: Xiànzài fāzuò de gèng pínfán le ma?
translation: 现在发作得更频繁了吗？

english: Where on your body is the rash?
transliteration: Pízhěn zhǎng zài nín shēntǐ de shénme bùwèi?
translation: 皮疹长在您身体的什么部位？

english: Is it on one side or both sides?
transliteration: Shì zài yí cè háishi liǎng cè?
translation: 是在一侧还是两侧？

english: Is it on your face or scalp?
transliteration: Shì zài nín de liǎn shàng huò tóupí shàng ma?
translation: 是在您的脸上或头皮上吗？

english: Is it on your hands, palms, or between your fingers?
transliteration: Shì zài nín de shǒu shàng, shǒuzhǎng shàng huò shǒuzhǐ zhījiān ma?
translation: 是在您的手上、手掌上或手指之间吗？

english: Is it on your feet, soles, or between your toes?
transliteration: Shì zài nín de jiǎo shàng, jiǎodǐ huò jiǎozhǐ zhījiān ma?
translation: 是在您的脚上、脚底或脚趾之间吗？

english: Is it in your armpits or groin?
transliteration: Shì zài nín de yèxià huò fùgǔgōu ma?
translation: 是在您的腋下或腹股沟吗？

english: Is it around your genitals or anus?
transliteration: Shì zài nín de shēngzhíqì huò gāngmén zhōuwéi ma?
translation: 是在您的生殖器或肛门周围吗？

english: Are the spots flat or raised?
transliteration: Zhèxiē bāndiǎn shì píng de háishi tūqǐ de?
translation: 这些斑点是平的还是凸起的？

english: Are there blisters or fluid-filled bumps?
transliteration: Yǒu shuǐpào huò lǐmiàn yǒu yètǐ de zhǒngkuài ma?
translation: 有水疱或里面有液体的肿块吗？

english: Is there scaling, flaking, or crusting?
transliteration: Pífū yǒu tuōxiè, qǐpí huò jiéjiā ma?
translation: 皮肤有脱屑、起皮或结痂吗？

english: Are the spots circular or ring-shaped?
transliteration: Zhèxiē bāndiǎn shì yuánxíng huò huánxíng de ma?
translation: 这些斑点是圆形或环形的吗？

english: Has the colour or size changed?
transliteration: Yánsè huò dàxiǎo yǒu biànhuà ma?
translation: 颜色或大小有变化吗？

english: Is the skin cracked or peeling?
transliteration: Pífū yǒu lièkǒu huò tuōpí ma?
translation: 皮肤有裂口或脱皮吗？

english: Does it itch?
transliteration: Huì yǎng ma?
translation: 会痒吗？

english: Where does it itch the most?
transliteration: Nǎlǐ zuì yǎng?
translation: 哪里最痒？

english: Is the itching worse at night?
transliteration: Wǎnshang huì gèng yǎng ma?
translation: 晚上会更痒吗？

english: Does the itching wake you from sleep?
transliteration: Yǎng de huì bǎ nín cóng shuìmèng zhōng nòng xǐng ma?
translation: 痒得会把您从睡梦中弄醒吗？

english: Does scratching make it worse?
transliteration: Zhuā náo huì ràng qíngkuàng gèng yánzhòng ma?
translation: 抓挠会让情况更严重吗？

english: Does anything relieve the itching?
transliteration: Yǒu shénme néng huǎnjiě sāoyǎng ma?
translation: 有什么能缓解瘙痒吗？

english: Is it painful, tender, or burning?
transliteration: Huì tòng, chùpèng shí huì tòng, háishi yǒu zhuóshāo gǎn?
translation: 会痛、触碰时会痛，还是有灼烧感？

english: Does the skin feel hot to touch?
transliteration: Mō qǐlái gǎnjué pífū fārè ma?
translation: 摸起来感觉皮肤发热吗？

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: Téngtòng chéngdù cóng líng dào shí yǒu jǐ fēn?
translation: 疼痛程度从零到十有几分？

english: Is the pain only when touched or also at rest?
transliteration: Zhǐyǒu pèng dào shí cái tòng, háishi xiūxi shí yě huì tòng?
translation: 只有碰到时才痛，还是休息时也会痛？

english: Do you have a fever or chills?
transliteration: Nín fāshāo huò fālěng ma?
translation: 您发烧或发冷吗？

english: Is the redness spreading quickly?
transliteration: Fā hóng de dìfang zhèngzài xùnsù kuòdà ma?
translation: 发红的地方正在迅速扩大吗？

english: Is there pus, drainage, or a bad smell?
transliteration: Yǒu nóng, shènyè huò nánwén de qìwèi ma?
translation: 有脓、渗液或难闻的气味吗？

english: Are there painful blisters?
transliteration: Yǒu téngtòng de shuǐpào ma?
translation: 有疼痛的水疱吗？

english: Do you feel generally unwell?
transliteration: Nín zhěngtǐ gǎnjué bù shūfu ma?
translation: 您整体感觉不舒服吗？

english: Is the rash near your eye or affecting your vision?
transliteration: Pízhěn kàojìn yǎnjing, huò yǐngxiǎng shìlì ma?
translation: 皮疹靠近眼睛，或影响视力吗？

english: Do you have sores inside your mouth or on your genitals?
transliteration: Nín de kǒuqiāng nèi huò shēngzhíqì shàng yǒu kuìyáng ma?
translation: 您的口腔内或生殖器上有溃疡吗？

english: Are you having trouble breathing or swelling of your lips or tongue?
transliteration: Nín hūxī kùnnan, huò zuǐchún, shétou zhǒngzhàng ma?
translation: 您呼吸困难，或嘴唇、舌头肿胀吗？

english: Have you started any new medication recently?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn kāishǐ fúyòng xīn de yàowù le ma?
translation: 您最近开始服用新的药物了吗？

english: Have you used any new soap, detergent, cream, or cosmetic?
transliteration: Nín yòng guo xīn de féizào, xǐyīyè, hùfūshuāng huò huàzhuāngpǐn ma?
translation: 您用过新的肥皂、洗衣液、护肤霜或化妆品吗？

english: Does it worsen after sun exposure?
transliteration: Shài tàiyáng hòu huì jiāzhòng ma?
translation: 晒太阳后会加重吗？

english: Does heat, sweating, or exercise make it worse?
transliteration: Rè, chūhàn huò yùndòng huì ràng qíngkuàng jiāzhòng ma?
translation: 热、出汗或运动会让情况加重吗？

english: Does cold weather or water trigger it?
transliteration: Lěngtiān huò jiēchù shuǐ huì yǐnfā zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng ma?
translation: 冷天或接触水会引发这种情况吗？

english: Does it happen after certain foods?
transliteration: Chī mǒuxiē shíwù hòu huì chūxiàn zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng ma?
translation: 吃某些食物后会出现这种情况吗？

english: Have you travelled recently?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn lǚxíng guo ma?
translation: 您最近旅行过吗？

english: Have you been bitten by an insect or tick?
transliteration: Nín bèi kūnchóng huò pí chóng dīngyǎo guo ma?
translation: 您被昆虫或蜱虫叮咬过吗？

english: Have you been around anyone with a similar rash or itching?
transliteration: Nín jiēchù guo yǒu lèisì pízhěn huò sāoyǎng de rén ma?
translation: 您接触过有类似皮疹或瘙痒的人吗？

english: Are there pets or animals at home?
transliteration: Jiālǐ yǒu chǒngwù huò qítā dòngwù ma?
translation: 家里有宠物或其他动物吗？

english: Are you exposed to chemicals or irritants at work?
transliteration: Nín zài gōngzuò zhōng huì jiēchù huàxuépǐn huò cìjīwù ma?
translation: 您在工作中会接触化学品或刺激物吗？

english: How long have you had this mole?
transliteration: Zhège zhì zhǎng le duōjiǔ le?
translation: 这个痣长了多久了？

english: Has this mole changed in size, shape, or colour?
transliteration: Zhège zhì de dàxiǎo, xíngzhuàng huò yánsè biàn le ma?
translation: 这个痣的大小、形状或颜色变了吗？

english: Does the mole bleed, itch, or hurt?
transliteration: Zhège zhì huì chūxuè, fāyǎng huò téngtòng ma?
translation: 这个痣会出血、发痒或疼痛吗？

english: Has the mole developed an irregular border?
transliteration: Zhège zhì de biānyuán biàn de bù guīzé le ma?
translation: 这个痣的边缘变得不规则了吗？

english: Have you noticed a new or unusual mole?
transliteration: Nín fāxiàn xīn de huò bù xúncháng de zhì le ma?
translation: 您发现新的或不寻常的痣了吗？

english: Have you ever had skin cancer or melanoma?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián dé guo pífū ái huò hēisèsùliú ma?
translation: 您以前得过皮肤癌或黑色素瘤吗？

english: Has anyone in your family had melanoma or skin cancer?
transliteration: Nín de jiārén zhōng yǒu rén dé guo hēisèsùliú huò pífū ái ma?
translation: 您的家人中有人得过黑色素瘤或皮肤癌吗？

english: Have you had frequent sunburns, especially in childhood?
transliteration: Nín jīngcháng shàishāng ma, yóuqí shì xiǎoshíhou?
translation: 您经常晒伤吗，尤其是小时候？

english: Do you use sunscreen or protective clothing?
transliteration: Nín huì shǐyòng fángshàishuāng huò chuān fánghù yīwù ma?
translation: 您会使用防晒霜或穿防护衣物吗？

english: Have you used tanning beds?
transliteration: Nín yòng guo rìguāngyù chuáng ma?
translation: 您用过日光浴床吗？

english: Have you ever had eczema?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián dé guo shīzhěn ma?
translation: 您以前得过湿疹吗？

english: Have you ever had psoriasis?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián dé guo yínxièbìng ma?
translation: 您以前得过银屑病吗？

english: Have you had acne or pimples?
transliteration: Nín zhǎng guo cuóchuāng huò fěncì ma?
translation: 您长过痤疮或粉刺吗？

english: Have you had hives or raised itchy welts?
transliteration: Nín qǐ guo xúnmázhěn huò fāyǎng de zhǒngkuài ma?
translation: 您起过荨麻疹或发痒的肿块吗？

english: Have you had a fungal skin infection?
transliteration: Nín dé guo pífū zhēnjūn gǎnrǎn ma?
translation: 您得过皮肤真菌感染吗？

english: Have you had warts?
transliteration: Nín zhǎng guo yóu ma?
translation: 您长过疣吗？

english: Have you had shingles?
transliteration: Nín dé guo dàizhuàngpàozhěn ma?
translation: 您得过带状疱疹吗？

english: Have you had scabies?
transliteration: Nín dé guo jièchuāng ma?
translation: 您得过疥疮吗？

english: Have you had head lice?
transliteration: Nín zhǎng guo tóushī ma?
translation: 您长过头虱吗？

english: Have you had cold sores around your lips?
transliteration: Nín de zuǐchún zhōuwéi zhǎng guo chún pàozhěn ma?
translation: 您的嘴唇周围长过唇疱疹吗？

english: Do you have very dry or sensitive skin?
transliteration: Nín de pífū fēicháng gānzào huò mǐngǎn ma?
translation: 您的皮肤非常干燥或敏感吗？

english: Have you noticed hair loss or thinning?
transliteration: Nín fāxiàn diào fà huò tóufa biàn xī le ma?
translation: 您发现掉发或头发变稀了吗？

english: Is the hair loss in patches or all over?
transliteration: Diào fà shì yí kuài yí kuài de, háishi zhěnggè tóubù dōu zài diào?
translation: 掉发是一块一块的，还是整个头部都在掉？

english: Is your scalp itchy, painful, or flaky?
transliteration: Nín de tóupí fāyǎng, téngtòng huò tuōxiè ma?
translation: 您的头皮发痒、疼痛或脱屑吗？

english: Have your nails changed colour or shape?
transliteration: Nín de zhǐjia huò zhǐjia yánsè huò xíngzhuàng biàn le ma?
translation: 您的指甲或趾甲颜色或形状变了吗？

english: Are your nails thickened, brittle, or separating from the skin?
transliteration: Nín de zhǐjia huò zhǐjia biàn hòu, yì suì, huò yǔ pífū fēnlí le ma?
translation: 您的指甲或趾甲变厚、易碎，或与皮肤分离了吗？

english: Do you have any allergies?
transliteration: Nín yǒu guòmǐn ma?
translation: 您有过敏吗？

english: Do you have asthma or seasonal allergies?
transliteration: Nín yǒu xiàochuǎn huò jìjiéxìng guòmǐn ma?
translation: 您有哮喘或季节性过敏吗？

english: Do you have diabetes or a condition affecting your immune system?
transliteration: Nín yǒu tángniàobìng huò yǐngxiǎng miǎnyì xìtǒng de jíbìng ma?
translation: 您有糖尿病或影响免疫系统的疾病吗？

english: Does anyone in your family have eczema, psoriasis, or similar skin problems?
transliteration: Nín de jiārén zhōng yǒu rén dé guo shīzhěn, yínxièbìng huò lèisì de pífū wèntí ma?
translation: 您的家人中有人得过湿疹、银屑病或类似的皮肤问题吗？

english: Are you pregnant or breastfeeding?
transliteration: Nín huáiyùn huò zhèngzài bǔrǔ ma?
translation: 您怀孕或正在哺乳吗？

english: What medicines and supplements do you take?
transliteration: Nín zài fúyòng nǎxiē yàowù hé bǔchōngjì?
translation: 您在服用哪些药物和补充剂？

english: Have you tried any treatment for this problem?
transliteration: Nín shì guo zhìliáo zhège wèntí ma?
translation: 您试过治疗这个问题吗？

english: What cream, lotion, or medicine have you used?
transliteration: Nín yòng guo shénme yàogāo, rǔyè huò yàowù?
translation: 您用过什么药膏、乳液或药物？

english: How often do you apply it?
transliteration: Nín duōjiǔ tú yí cì?
translation: 您多久涂一次？

english: How long have you been using it?
transliteration: Nín yòng le duōjiǔ le?
translation: 您用了多久了？

english: When did you last use it?
transliteration: Nín shàng cì shǐyòng shì shénme shíhou?
translation: 您上次使用是什么时候？

english: Did it help or make the problem worse?
transliteration: Tā yǒu bāngzhù, háishi ràng wèntí gèng yánzhòng le?
translation: 它有帮助，还是让问题更严重了？

english: Have you used a steroid or cortisone cream?
transliteration: Nín yòng guo lèigùchún huò kědìsōng yàogāo ma?
translation: 您用过类固醇或可的松药膏吗？

english: Did you stop any treatment? Why?
transliteration: Nín tíngyòng guo rènhé zhìliáo ma? Wèishénme?
translation: 您停用过任何治疗吗？为什么？

english: Have you seen a dermatologist for this before?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián yīnwèi zhège wèntí kàn guo pífūkē yīshēng ma?
translation: 您以前因为这个问题看过皮肤科医生吗？

english: Please roll up your sleeves.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ xiùzi juǎn qǐlái.
translation: 请把袖子卷起来。

english: Please turn around so I can examine your back.
transliteration: Qǐng zhuǎn guò shēn lái, ràng wǒ jiǎnchá nín de bèibù.
translation: 请转过身来，让我检查您的背部。

english: I am going to examine your scalp and nails.
transliteration: Wǒ yào jiǎnchá nín de tóupí hé zhǐjia.
translation: 我要检查您的头皮和指甲。

english: I am going to look at this with a magnifying light.
transliteration: Wǒ yào yòng dài fàngdàjìng de dēng jiǎnchá zhèlǐ.
translation: 我要用带放大镜的灯检查这里。

english: We may need to take a small skin sample (biopsy).
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng xūyào qǔ yì xiǎo kuài pífū yàngběn (huójiǎn).
translation: 我们可能需要取一小块皮肤样本（活检）。

english: We may take a skin scraping to test for fungus.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng huì guāqǔ yìdiǎn pífū, jiǎnchá shìfǒu yǒu zhēnjūn.
translation: 我们可能会刮取一点皮肤，检查是否有真菌。

english: We may take a sample from your nail.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng huì cóng nín de zhǐjia huò zhǐjia qǔyàng.
translation: 我们可能会从您的指甲或趾甲取样。

english: I am going to clean the area first.
transliteration: Wǒ xiān qīngjié yíxià zhège bùwèi.
translation: 我先清洁一下这个部位。

english: You may feel a small pinch.
transliteration: Nín kěnéng huì gǎnjué dào qīngwēi de cìtòng.
translation: 您可能会感觉到轻微的刺痛。

english: I will prescribe a cream or ointment.
transliteration: Wǒ huì gěi nín kāi yì zhǒng yàogāo huò ruǎngāo.
translation: 我会给您开一种药膏或软膏。

english: Apply a thin layer to the affected skin.
transliteration: Zài shòu yǐngxiǎng de pífū shàng báobáo de tú yì céng.
translation: 在受影响的皮肤上薄薄地涂一层。

english: How many times a day were you told to apply it?
transliteration: Yīshēng gàosu nín měitiān tú jǐ cì?
translation: 医生告诉您每天涂几次？

english: For how many days were you told to use it?
transliteration: Yīshēng gàosu nín yòng jǐ tiān?
translation: 医生告诉您用几天？

english: Avoid scratching or picking the skin.
transliteration: Qǐng búyào zhuā náo huò kōu pífū.
translation: 请不要抓挠或抠皮肤。

english: Use a gentle, fragrance-free moisturizer.
transliteration: Qǐng shǐyòng wēnhé, wú xiāngwèi de bǎoshīshuāng.
translation: 请使用温和、无香味的保湿霜。

english: Keep the area clean and dry.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎochí zhège bùwèi qīngjié gānzào.
translation: 请保持这个部位清洁干燥。

english: Avoid the product that seems to trigger the rash.
transliteration: Qǐng bìmiǎn shǐyòng sìhū huì yǐnfā pízhěn de chǎnpǐn.
translation: 请避免使用似乎会引发皮疹的产品。

english: Use sunscreen and protect your skin from the sun.
transliteration: Qǐng shǐyòng fángshàishuāng bìng bǎohù pífū, bìmiǎn yángguāng zhàoshè.
translation: 请使用防晒霜并保护皮肤，避免阳光照射。

english: The examination is finished. Thank you.
transliteration: Jiǎnchá jiéshù le. Xièxie.
translation: 检查结束了。谢谢。

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: Wǒmen huì wèi nín ānpái fùzhěn.
translation: 我们会为您安排复诊。

english: Please return if the rash worsens or spreads.
transliteration: Rúguǒ pízhěn jiāzhòng huò kuòsàn, qǐng huílái jiùzhěn.
translation: 如果皮疹加重或扩散，请回来就诊。

english: Seek urgent medical care if you have trouble breathing or rapidly worsening symptoms.
transliteration: Rúguǒ nín hūxī kùnnan huò zhèngzhuàng xùnsù jiāzhòng, qǐng lìjí jiùyī.
translation: 如果您呼吸困难或症状迅速加重，请立即就医。

english: We will use a professional interpreter to explain the results and treatment.
transliteration: Wǒmen huì qǐng zhuānyè kǒuyìyuán wèi nín jiěshì jiǎnchá jiéguǒ hé zhìliáo fāng'àn.
translation: 我们会请专业口译员为您解释检查结果和治疗方案。

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: Nín jīntiān wèishénme lái kànzhěn?
translation: 您今天为什么来看诊？

english: Where does it hurt? Please point to the area.
transliteration: Nǎli téng? Qǐng zhǐchū téng de dìfang.
translation: 哪里疼？请指出疼的地方。

english: Is the pain on the right, left, or both sides?
transliteration: Téngtòng shì zài yòucè, zuǒcè, háishi liǎng cè dōu yǒu?
translation: 疼痛是在右侧、左侧，还是两侧都有？

english: When did the pain start?
transliteration: Téngtòng shì shénme shíhou kāishǐ de?
translation: 疼痛是什么时候开始的？

english: Did it start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: Téngtòng shì tūrán kāishǐ de, háishi mànmàn chūxiàn de?
translation: 疼痛是突然开始的，还是慢慢出现的？

english: How long have you had this problem?
transliteration: Zhège wèntí chíxù duōjiǔ le?
translation: 这个问题持续多久了？

english: Is the pain constant or does it come and go?
transliteration: Téngtòng yìzhí chíxù, háishi shí yǒu shí wú?
translation: 疼痛一直持续，还是时有时无？

english: Is the pain getting better or worse?
transliteration: Téngtòng shì zài hǎozhuǎn háishi jiāzhòng?
translation: 疼痛是在好转还是加重？

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: Rúguǒ cóng líng dào shí píngfēn, téngtòng yǒu duō yánzhòng?
translation: 如果从零到十评分，疼痛有多严重？

english: Is the pain sharp, dull, burning, or throbbing?
transliteration: Téngtòng shì cìtòng, dùntòng, zhuótòng, háishi tiàotòng?
translation: 疼痛是刺痛、钝痛、灼痛，还是跳痛？

english: Does the pain spread anywhere else?
transliteration: Téngtòng huì kuòsàn dào qítā dìfang ma?
translation: 疼痛会扩散到其他地方吗？

english: Have you had this pain before?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián yǒu guo zhè zhǒng téngtòng ma?
translation: 您以前有过这种疼痛吗？

english: Did you fall or have an accident?
transliteration: Nín shuāidǎo guo huò chū guo shìgù ma?
translation: 您摔倒过或出过事故吗？

english: When did the injury happen?
transliteration: Nín shì shénme shíhou shòushāng de?
translation: 您是什么时候受伤的？

english: How did you injure yourself?
transliteration: Nín shì zěnme shòushāng de?
translation: 您是怎么受伤的？

english: Did you get hit directly in that area?
transliteration: Nàge bùwèi bèi zhíjiē zhuàng dào le ma?
translation: 那个部位被直接撞到了吗？

english: Did you twist your ankle or knee?
transliteration: Nín de jiǎohuái huò xīgài niǔ dào le ma?
translation: 您的脚踝或膝盖扭到了吗？

english: Did you fall onto an outstretched hand?
transliteration: Nín shuāidǎo shí yòng shēnchū de shǒu chēng dì le ma?
translation: 您摔倒时用伸出的手撑地了吗？

english: Did you hear or feel a pop or crack?
transliteration: Nín tīngdào huò gǎnjué dào “pā” huò “kā” de yì shēng ma?
translation: 您听到或感觉到“啪”或“咔”的一声吗？

english: Did the swelling start immediately?
transliteration: Zhǒngzhàng shì mǎshàng chūxiàn de ma?
translation: 肿胀是马上出现的吗？

english: Could you walk right after the injury?
transliteration: Shòushāng hòu nín néng mǎshàng zǒulù ma?
translation: 受伤后您能马上走路吗？

english: Did you continue playing or working after the injury?
transliteration: Shòushāng hòu nín hái jìxù yùndòng huò gōngzuò le ma?
translation: 受伤后您还继续运动或工作了吗？

english: Was this related to sports, work, or lifting something heavy?
transliteration: Zhè hé yùndòng, gōngzuò huò bān zhòngwù yǒuguān ma?
translation: 这和运动、工作或搬重物有关吗？

english: Did you injure your head or neck as well?
transliteration: Nín de tóubù huò jǐngbù yě shòushāng le ma?
translation: 您的头部或颈部也受伤了吗？

english: Does it hurt more when you move?
transliteration: Nín huódòng shí huì gèng téng ma?
translation: 您活动时会更疼吗？

english: Does it hurt more when you walk or stand?
transliteration: Nín zǒulù huò zhànlì shí huì gèng téng ma?
translation: 您走路或站立时会更疼吗？

english: Does it hurt more when you sit or bend forward?
transliteration: Nín zuòzhe huò xiàng qián wānyāo shí huì gèng téng ma?
translation: 您坐着或向前弯腰时会更疼吗？

english: Does the pain improve with rest?
transliteration: Xiūxi hòu téngtòng huì jiǎnqīng ma?
translation: 休息后疼痛会减轻吗？

english: Does the pain wake you up at night?
transliteration: Téngtòng huì ràng nín yèlǐ xǐnglái ma?
translation: 疼痛会让您夜里醒来吗？

english: Do you have stiffness in the morning?
transliteration: Nín zǎoshang huì juéde jiāngyìng ma?
translation: 您早上会觉得僵硬吗？

english: How long does the morning stiffness last?
transliteration: Zǎoshang de jiāngyìng huì chíxù duōjiǔ?
translation: 早上的僵硬会持续多久？

english: Can you do your usual daily activities?
transliteration: Nín néng zuò píngshí de rìcháng huódòng ma?
translation: 您能做平时的日常活动吗？

english: Can you walk without assistance?
transliteration: Nín néng dúzì zǒulù ma?
translation: 您能独自走路吗？

english: How far can you walk before you need to stop?
transliteration: Nín zǒu duō yuǎn hòu xūyào tíng xiàlái?
translation: 您走多远后需要停下来？

english: Can you climb stairs?
transliteration: Nín néng pá lóutī ma?
translation: 您能爬楼梯吗？

english: Does the joint lock, catch, or give way?
transliteration: Guānjié huì kǎzhù, kǎdùn huò tūrán wúlì ma?
translation: 关节会卡住、卡顿或突然无力吗？

english: Is the area swollen?
transliteration: Zhège bùwèi zhǒng le ma?
translation: 这个部位肿了吗？

english: Is the area red or warm to touch?
transliteration: Zhège bùwèi fāhóng huò mō qǐlái fārè ma?
translation: 这个部位发红或摸起来发热吗？

english: Do you have a fever or feel unwell?
transliteration: Nín fāshāo huò juéde bù shūfu ma?
translation: 您发烧或觉得不舒服吗？

english: Do you feel numbness or tingling?
transliteration: Nín juéde mámù huò yǒu cìtòng gǎn ma?
translation: 您觉得麻木或有刺痛感吗？

english: Do you have weakness in your arm or leg?
transliteration: Nín de shǒubì huò tuǐ wúlì ma?
translation: 您的手臂或腿无力吗？

english: Can you feel me touching your fingers or toes?
transliteration: Nín néng gǎnjué dào wǒ chùpèng nín de shǒuzhǐ huò jiǎozhǐ ma?
translation: 您能感觉到我触碰您的手指或脚趾吗？

english: Have your fingers or toes become cold or pale?
transliteration: Nín de shǒuzhǐ huò jiǎozhǐ biàn lěng huò biàn bái le ma?
translation: 您的手指或脚趾变冷或变白了吗？

english: Do you have new difficulty controlling your urine or stool?
transliteration: Nín zuìjìn yǒu xīn de páiniào huò páibiàn kòngzhì kùnnán ma?
translation: 您最近有新的排尿或排便控制困难吗？

english: Do you have numbness around your groin or between your legs?
transliteration: Nín de fùgǔgōu zhōuwéi huò liǎng tuǐ zhījiān yǒu mámù gǎn ma?
translation: 您的腹股沟周围或两腿之间有麻木感吗？

english: Have you had unexplained weight loss?
transliteration: Nín yǒu méiyǒu bù míng yuányīn de tǐzhòng xiàjiàng?
translation: 您有没有不明原因地体重下降？

english: Does your neck hurt?
transliteration: Nín de bózi téng ma?
translation: 您的脖子疼吗？

english: Does your upper or lower back hurt?
transliteration: Nín de shàng bèibù huò xià bèibù téng ma?
translation: 您的上背部或下背部疼吗？

english: Does the pain travel down your arm?
transliteration: Téngtòng huì yánzhe shǒubì wǎng xià yánshēn ma?
translation: 疼痛会沿着手臂往下延伸吗？

english: Does the pain travel down your buttock or leg?
transliteration: Téngtòng huì yánzhe túnbù huò tuǐ wǎng xià yánshēn ma?
translation: 疼痛会沿着臀部或腿往下延伸吗？

english: Is the pain worse when you cough or sneeze?
transliteration: Késou huò dǎ pēntì shí téngtòng huì jiāzhòng ma?
translation: 咳嗽或打喷嚏时疼痛会加重吗？

english: Is bending forward or backward painful?
transliteration: Xiàng qián huò xiàng hòu wānyāo huì téng ma?
translation: 向前或向后弯腰会疼吗？

english: Have you had a slipped or herniated disc before?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián dé guo zhuījiānpán tūchū ma?
translation: 您以前得过椎间盘突出吗？

english: Have you had back surgery before?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián zuò guo bèibù shǒushù ma?
translation: 您以前做过背部手术吗？

english: Does your shoulder hurt?
transliteration: Nín de jiānbǎng téng ma?
translation: 您的肩膀疼吗？

english: Can you lift your arm above your head?
transliteration: Nín néng bǎ shǒubì jǔ guò tóudǐng ma?
translation: 您能把手臂举过头顶吗？

english: Does your shoulder feel unstable or pop out?
transliteration: Nín de jiānbǎng gǎnjué bù wěn huò huì tuō chūlái ma?
translation: 您的肩膀感觉不稳或会脱出来吗？

english: Does your elbow hurt?
transliteration: Nín de zhǒubù téng ma?
translation: 您的肘部疼吗？

english: Does your wrist hurt?
transliteration: Nín de shǒuwàn téng ma?
translation: 您的手腕疼吗？

english: Do you have pain or swelling in your fingers?
transliteration: Nín de shǒuzhǐ téng huò zhǒng ma?
translation: 您的手指疼或肿吗？

english: Can you make a fist?
transliteration: Nín néng wòquán ma?
translation: 您能握拳吗？

english: Can you grip or hold objects normally?
transliteration: Nín néng xiàng píngcháng yíyàng zhuāwò huò ná dōngxi ma?
translation: 您能像平常一样抓握或拿东西吗？

english: Do your fingers become numb at night?
transliteration: Nín de shǒuzhǐ yèlǐ huì má ma?
translation: 您的手指夜里会麻吗？

english: Does your hip or groin hurt?
transliteration: Nín de kuānbù huò fùgǔgōu téng ma?
translation: 您的髋部或腹股沟疼吗？

english: Does your knee hurt?
transliteration: Nín de xīgài téng ma?
translation: 您的膝盖疼吗？

english: Does your knee swell after activity?
transliteration: Huódòng hòu nín de xīgài huì zhǒng ma?
translation: 活动后您的膝盖会肿吗？

english: Does your knee lock or give way?
transliteration: Nín de xīgài huì kǎzhù huò tūrán wúlì ma?
translation: 您的膝盖会卡住或突然无力吗？

english: Does your ankle hurt?
transliteration: Nín de jiǎohuái téng ma?
translation: 您的脚踝疼吗？

english: Does your foot or heel hurt?
transliteration: Nín de jiǎo huò jiǎogēn téng ma?
translation: 您的脚或脚跟疼吗？

english: Can you put weight on the injured leg?
transliteration: Shòushāng de nà tiáo tuǐ néng chéngshòu zhòngliàng ma?
translation: 受伤的那条腿能承受重量吗？

english: Can you take four steps?
transliteration: Nín néng zǒu sì bù ma?
translation: 您能走四步吗？

english: Do you have pain in your calf?
transliteration: Nín de xiǎotuǐdù téng ma?
translation: 您的小腿肚疼吗？

english: Is one calf more swollen than the other?
transliteration: Yí cè xiǎotuǐdù bǐ lìng yí cè zhǒng ma?
translation: 一侧小腿肚比另一侧肿吗？

english: Have you been diagnosed with arthritis?
transliteration: Nín bèi zhěnduàn chū huàn yǒu guānjiéyán ma?
translation: 您被诊断出患有关节炎吗？

english: Have you been diagnosed with osteoarthritis?
transliteration: Nín bèi zhěnduàn chū huàn yǒu gǔ guānjiéyán ma?
translation: 您被诊断出患有骨关节炎吗？

english: Have you been diagnosed with rheumatoid arthritis?
transliteration: Nín bèi zhěnduàn chū huàn yǒu lèifēngshī guānjiéyán ma?
translation: 您被诊断出患有类风湿关节炎吗？

english: Have you been diagnosed with osteoporosis or weak bones?
transliteration: Nín bèi zhěnduàn chū huàn yǒu gǔzhì shūsōngzhèng huò gǔgé cuìruò ma?
translation: 您被诊断出患有骨质疏松症或骨骼脆弱吗？

english: Have you broken a bone before?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián gǔzhé guò ma?
translation: 您以前骨折过吗？

english: Have you had a bone density test?
transliteration: Nín zuò guò gǔ mìdù jiǎnchá ma?
translation: 您做过骨密度检查吗？

english: Do you have pain or swelling in several joints?
transliteration: Nín yǒu hǎo jǐ ge guānjié téngtòng huò zhǒngzhàng ma?
translation: 您有好几个关节疼痛或肿胀吗？

english: Does anyone in your family have arthritis or osteoporosis?
transliteration: Nín jiālǐ yǒu rén huàn yǒu guānjiéyán huò gǔzhì shūsōngzhèng ma?
translation: 您家里有人患有关节炎或骨质疏松症吗？

english: Have you had surgery on a bone or joint?
transliteration: Nín zuò guò gǔtou huò guānjié shǒushù ma?
translation: 您做过骨头或关节手术吗？

english: Have you had a hip or knee replacement?
transliteration: Nín zuò guò kuān guānjié huò xī guānjié zhìhuàn shǒushù ma?
translation: 您做过髋关节或膝关节置换手术吗？

english: Have you ever had a cast or splint?
transliteration: Nín yǐqián dǎ guò shígāo huò yòng guò jiábǎn ma?
translation: 您以前打过石膏或用过夹板吗？

english: Have you tried physiotherapy?
transliteration: Nín shì guò wùlǐ zhìliáo ma?
translation: 您试过物理治疗吗？

english: What medicines have you taken for the pain?
transliteration: Nín wèile zhǐtòng chī guò nǎxiē yào?
translation: 您为了止痛吃过哪些药？

english: Have you taken ibuprofen, naproxen, or diclofenac (Voltaren)?
transliteration: Nín chī guò bùluòfēn, nàipǔshēng huò shuānglǜfēnsuān (Voltaren) ma?
translation: 您吃过布洛芬、萘普生或双氯芬酸（Voltaren）吗？

english: How much medicine do you take and how often?
transliteration: Nín měi cì chī duōshǎo yào? Duōjiǔ chī yí cì?
translation: 您每次吃多少药？多久吃一次？

english: How long have you been taking it?
transliteration: Nín chī zhège yào duōjiǔ le?
translation: 您吃这个药多久了？

english: Has the medicine helped?
transliteration: Zhège yào yǒu bāngzhù ma?
translation: 这个药有帮助吗？

english: Do you take blood thinners or steroid medicines?
transliteration: Nín fúyòng kàngníngxuè yào huò lèigùchún yàowù ma?
translation: 您服用抗凝血药或类固醇药物吗？

english: Do you have any medication allergies?
transliteration: Nín duì shénme yàowù guòmǐn ma?
translation: 您对什么药物过敏吗？

english: I am going to examine the painful area.
transliteration: Wǒ xiànzài yào jiǎnchá nín téngtòng de bùwèi.
translation: 我现在要检查您疼痛的部位。

english: Please tell me if anything hurts.
transliteration: Rúguǒ yǒu nǎlǐ téng, qǐng gàosu wǒ.
translation: 如果有哪里疼，请告诉我。

english: Please stand up.
transliteration: Qǐng zhàn qǐlái.
translation: 请站起来。

english: Please sit down.
transliteration: Qǐng zuò xià.
translation: 请坐下。

english: Please lie on your back.
transliteration: Qǐng yǎngwò.
translation: 请仰卧。

english: Please lie on your stomach.
transliteration: Qǐng pā xià.
translation: 请趴下。

english: Please walk a few steps.
transliteration: Qǐng zǒu jǐ bù.
translation: 请走几步。

english: Please walk on your toes.
transliteration: Qǐng diǎn zhe jiǎojiān zǒu.
translation: 请踮着脚尖走。

english: Please walk on your heels.
transliteration: Qǐng yòng jiǎogēn zǒu.
translation: 请用脚跟走。

english: Bend forward, please.
transliteration: Qǐng xiàng qián wānyāo.
translation: 请向前弯腰。

english: Bend your knee, please.
transliteration: Qǐng wānqū xīgài.
translation: 请弯曲膝盖。

english: Straighten your knee, please.
transliteration: Qǐng shēnzhí xīgài.
translation: 请伸直膝盖。

english: Raise your arm, please.
transliteration: Qǐng tái qǐ shǒubì.
translation: 请抬起手臂。

english: Make a fist and then open your hand.
transliteration: Qǐng wò jǐn quántou, ránhòu zhāng kāi shǒu.
translation: 请握紧拳头，然后张开手。

english: Spread your fingers apart.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ shǒuzhǐ fēn kāi.
translation: 请把手指分开。

english: Push against my hand.
transliteration: Qǐng yòng lì dǐ zhù wǒ de shǒu.
translation: 请用力抵住我的手。

english: Pull against my hand.
transliteration: Qǐng yòng lì lā wǒ de shǒu.
translation: 请用力拉我的手。

english: Please relax your muscles.
transliteration: Qǐng fàngsōng jīròu.
translation: 请放松肌肉。

english: Tell me if you feel this touch.
transliteration: Rúguǒ nín gǎnjué dào wǒ pèng le zhèlǐ, qǐng gàosu wǒ.
translation: 如果您感觉到我碰了这里，请告诉我。

english: I am going to examine your joints and muscles.
transliteration: Wǒ xiànzài yào jiǎnchá nín de guānjié hé jīròu.
translation: 我现在要检查您的关节和肌肉。

english: Please tell me if anything hurts during the examination.
transliteration: Jiǎnchá shí rúguǒ yǒu nǎlǐ téng, qǐng gàosu wǒ.
translation: 检查时如果有哪里疼，请告诉我。

english: Please stand up straight.
transliteration: Qǐng zhàn zhí.
translation: 请站直。

english: Please walk across the room and come back.
transliteration: Qǐng zǒu dào fángjiān nàbiān, zài zǒu huílái.
translation: 请走到房间那边，再走回来。

english: Please walk on your heels.
transliteration: Qǐng yòng jiǎogēn zǒu.
translation: 请用脚跟走。

english: Please walk on your toes.
transliteration: Qǐng diǎn zhe jiǎojiān zǒu.
translation: 请踮着脚尖走。

english: Please try walking in a straight line, heel to toe.
transliteration: Qǐng shì zhe jiǎogēn āi zhe jiǎojiān zǒu zhíxiàn.
translation: 请试着脚跟挨着脚尖走直线。

english: Please stand on one leg.
transliteration: Qǐng dān tuǐ zhàn lì.
translation: 请单腿站立。

english: Please squat down as far as you comfortably can.
transliteration: Qǐng jǐnliàng dūn xià, yǐ nín juéde shūfu wéi dù.
translation: 请尽量蹲下，以您觉得舒服为度。

english: Please sit down and stand up without using your hands, if you can.
transliteration: Rúguǒ kěyǐ, qǐng bú yòng shǒu, zuò xià zài zhàn qǐlái.
translation: 如果可以，请不用手，坐下再站起来。

english: Can you put your full weight on this leg?
transliteration: Nín néng bǎ quánbù tǐzhòng yā zài zhè tiáo tuǐ shàng ma?
translation: 您能把全部体重压在这条腿上吗？

english: Please lie on your back.
transliteration: Qǐng yǎngwò.
translation: 请仰卧。

english: Please lie on your stomach.
transliteration: Qǐng pā xià.
translation: 请趴下。

english: Please turn onto your side.
transliteration: Qǐng zhuǎn wéi cèwò.
translation: 请转为侧卧。

english: I am going to press gently on this area.
transliteration: Wǒ xiànzài yào qīngqīng ànyā zhège bùwèi.
translation: 我现在要轻轻按压这个部位。

english: Does it hurt when I press here?
transliteration: Wǒ àn zhèlǐ shí, nín huì téng ma?
translation: 我按这里时，您会疼吗？

english: Is the pain in the muscle, bone, or joint?
transliteration: Téngtòng shì zài jīròu, gǔtou háishi guānjié?
translation: 疼痛是在肌肉、骨头还是关节？

english: Please relax your muscles.
transliteration: Qǐng fàngsōng jīròu.
translation: 请放松肌肉。

english: I will move your arm or leg for you; try to relax.
transliteration: Wǒ lái bāng nín huódòng shǒubì huò tuǐ, qǐng jǐnliàng fàngsōng.
translation: 我来帮您活动手臂或腿，请尽量放松。

english: Please look down and bring your chin toward your chest.
transliteration: Qǐng dītóu, bǎ xiàba kàojìn xiōngkǒu.
translation: 请低头，把下巴靠近胸口。

english: Please look up toward the ceiling.
transliteration: Qǐng táitóu kàn tiānhuābǎn.
translation: 请抬头看天花板。

english: Please turn your head to the left and then to the right.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ tóu zhuǎn xiàng zuǒbian, zài zhuǎn xiàng yòubian.
translation: 请把头转向左边，再转向右边。

english: Please tilt your ear toward your shoulder.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ ěrduo kào xiàng jiānbǎng.
translation: 请把耳朵靠向肩膀。

english: Please bend forward and try to touch your toes.
transliteration: Qǐng xiàng qián wānyāo, shì zhe mō dào jiǎozhǐ.
translation: 请向前弯腰，试着摸到脚趾。

english: Please lean backward as far as is comfortable.
transliteration: Qǐng jǐnliàng xiàng hòu yǎng, yǐ nín juéde shūfu wéi dù.
translation: 请尽量向后仰，以您觉得舒服为度。

english: Please bend sideways to each side.
transliteration: Qǐng xiàng liǎng cè wānyāo.
translation: 请向两侧弯腰。

english: Please twist your upper body to the left and right.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ shàng bànshēn xiàng zuǒ, xiàng yòu zhuǎn.
translation: 请把上半身向左、向右转。

english: I will raise your straight leg; tell me if pain travels down it.
transliteration: Wǒ huì tái qǐ nín shēnzhí de tuǐ; rúguǒ téngtòng yán zhe tuǐ wǎng xià zǒu, qǐng gàosu wǒ.
translation: 我会抬起您伸直的腿；如果疼痛沿着腿往下走，请告诉我。

english: Does this movement cause tingling or pain down your arm?
transliteration: Zuò zhège dòngzuò shí, nín de shǒubì huì yǒu cìtòng huò téngtòng ma?
translation: 做这个动作时，您的手臂会有刺痛或疼痛吗？

english: Please lift your hips off the bed.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ túnbù tái lí chuángmiàn.
translation: 请把臀部抬离床面。

english: Please lift both arms straight in front of you.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ shuāngbì shēnzhí, zài shēnqián tái qǐlái.
translation: 请把双臂伸直，在身前抬起来。

english: Please raise both arms out to your sides.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ shuāngbì xiàng liǎng cè tái qǐ.
translation: 请把双臂向两侧抬起。

english: Please lift your arms above your head.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ shuāngbì jǔ guò tóudǐng.
translation: 请把双臂举过头顶。

english: Please reach behind your head.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ shǒu shēn dào tóu hòumiàn.
translation: 请把手伸到头后面。

english: Please reach behind your back.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ shǒu shēn dào bèihòu.
translation: 请把手伸到背后。

english: Keep your elbow by your side and turn your hand outward.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ shǒuzhǒu tiē zài shēntǐ pángbiān, shǒu xiàng wài zhuǎn.
translation: 请把手肘贴在身体旁边，手向外转。

english: Keep your elbow by your side and turn your hand inward.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ shǒuzhǒu tiē zài shēntǐ pángbiān, shǒu xiàng nèi zhuǎn.
translation: 请把手肘贴在身体旁边，手向内转。

english: Please push your arm upward against my hand.
transliteration: Qǐng yòng shǒubì xiàng shàng tuī wǒ de shǒu.
translation: 请用手臂向上推我的手。

english: Please keep your arm up while I gently push down.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎochí shǒubì tái qǐ, wǒ huì qīngqīng xiàng xià tuī.
translation: 请保持手臂抬起，我会轻轻向下推。

english: Please bring your arm across your chest.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ shǒubì héng zhe fàng dào xiōngqián.
translation: 请把手臂横着放到胸前。

english: Please bend and straighten your elbow.
transliteration: Qǐng wānqū bìng shēnzhí shǒuzhǒu.
translation: 请弯曲并伸直手肘。

english: Please turn your palm up, then down.
transliteration: Qǐng xiān bǎ shǒuzhǎng cháo shàng, zài cháo xià.
translation: 请先把手掌朝上，再朝下。

english: Please bend your wrist up and down.
transliteration: Qǐng shàngxià wāndòng shǒuwàn.
translation: 请上下弯动手腕。

english: Please move your wrist from side to side.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ shǒuwàn zuǒyòu zhuǎndòng.
translation: 请把手腕左右转动。

english: Please make a fist.
transliteration: Qǐng wò quán.
translation: 请握拳。

english: Please open your hand and spread your fingers.
transliteration: Qǐng zhāng kāi shǒu, bǎ shǒuzhǐ fēn kāi.
translation: 请张开手，把手指分开。

english: Please touch your thumb to each fingertip.
transliteration: Qǐng yòng mǔzhǐ yīcì pèng qítā měi gēn shǒuzhǐ de zhǐjiān.
translation: 请用拇指依次碰其他每根手指的指尖。

english: Please squeeze my fingers as hard as you can.
transliteration: Qǐng jìn quánlì wò jǐn wǒ de shǒuzhǐ.
translation: 请尽全力握紧我的手指。

english: Please hold your fingers apart while I push them together.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ shǒuzhǐ fēn kāi, wǒ huì shì zhe bǎ tāmen tuī lǒng.
translation: 请把手指分开，我会试着把它们推拢。

english: Please straighten your fingers against my hand.
transliteration: Qǐng dǐ zhù wǒ de shǒu, bǎ shǒuzhǐ shēnzhí.
translation: 请抵住我的手，把手指伸直。

english: Does tapping here cause tingling in your fingers?
transliteration: Qiāo zhèlǐ huì ràng nín de shǒuzhǐ yǒu cìtòng gǎn ma?
translation: 敲这里会让您的手指有刺痛感吗？

english: Please bend both wrists and hold the backs of your hands together.
transliteration: Qǐng wānqū shuāng shǒuwàn, ràng shǒubèi tiē zài yìqǐ.
translation: 请弯曲双手腕，让手背贴在一起。

english: Please grip my fingers and do not let go.
transliteration: Qǐng zhuā zhù wǒ de shǒuzhǐ, bú yào sōng kāi.
translation: 请抓住我的手指，不要松开。

english: Please bring your knee toward your chest.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ xīgài tái xiàng xiōngkǒu.
translation: 请把膝盖抬向胸口。

english: Please move your leg out to the side.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ tuǐ xiàng pángbiān yí kāi.
translation: 请把腿向旁边移开。

english: Please bring your leg back toward the middle.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ tuǐ yí huí zhōngjiān.
translation: 请把腿移回中间。

english: I will gently rotate your hip; tell me if it hurts.
transliteration: Wǒ huì qīngqīng zhuǎndòng nín de kuānbù; rúguǒ téng, qǐng gàosu wǒ.
translation: 我会轻轻转动您的髋部；如果疼，请告诉我。

english: Please bend your knee and let it fall outward.
transliteration: Qǐng wānqū xīgài, ràng tā xiàng wài dǎo.
translation: 请弯曲膝盖，让它向外倒。

english: Please lift your straight leg off the bed.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ shēnzhí de tuǐ tái lí chuángmiàn.
translation: 请把伸直的腿抬离床面。

english: Please push your knee outward against my hand.
transliteration: Qǐng yòng xīgài xiàng wài tuī wǒ de shǒu.
translation: 请用膝盖向外推我的手。

english: Please stand on one leg while I check your hips.
transliteration: Qǐng dān tuǐ zhàn lì, wǒ lái jiǎnchá nín de kuānbù.
translation: 请单腿站立，我来检查您的髋部。

english: Please bend your knee as far as you can.
transliteration: Qǐng jǐnliàng wānqū xīgài.
translation: 请尽量弯曲膝盖。

english: Please straighten your knee completely.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ xīgài wánquán shēn zhí.
translation: 请把膝盖完全伸直。

english: Please tighten the muscles at the front of your thigh.
transliteration: Qǐng bēngjǐn dàtuǐ qiánmiàn de jīròu.
translation: 请绷紧大腿前面的肌肉。

english: Please lift your straight leg while keeping your knee straight.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎochí xīgài shēn zhí, bǎ shēnzhí de tuǐ tái qǐlái.
translation: 请保持膝盖伸直，把伸直的腿抬起来。

english: I will gently move your kneecap.
transliteration: Wǒ huì qīngqīng huódòng yíxià nín de xīgài gǔ.
translation: 我会轻轻活动一下您的膝盖骨。

english: I will gently test whether your knee feels stable.
transliteration: Wǒ huì qīngqīng jiǎnchá yíxià nín de xīgài shìfǒu wěngù.
translation: 我会轻轻检查一下您的膝盖是否稳固。

english: Does your knee click, catch, or lock when you move it?
transliteration: Nín huódòng xīgài shí, huì yǒu kādā shēng, kǎ zhù huò suǒ zhù de gǎnjué ma?
translation: 您活动膝盖时，会有咔嗒声、卡住或锁住的感觉吗？

english: Does your knee feel like it might give way?
transliteration: Nín juéde xīgài kěnéng huì tūrán chēng bú zhù ma?
translation: 您觉得膝盖可能会突然撑不住吗？

english: Please take a few steps and turn around.
transliteration: Qǐng zǒu jǐ bù, ránhòu zhuǎn guò shēn lái.
translation: 请走几步，然后转过身来。

english: Please do a small squat if you feel safe doing so.
transliteration: Rúguǒ nín juéde zhèyàng ānquán, qǐng shāowēi dūn yíxià.
translation: 如果您觉得这样安全，请稍微蹲一下。

english: Please point your toes down.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ jiǎojiān xiàng xià yā.
translation: 请把脚尖向下压。

english: Please pull your toes up toward your head.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ jiǎojiān wǎng shàng gōu, cháoxiàng nín de tóubù.
translation: 请把脚尖往上勾，朝向您的头部。

english: Please turn the sole of your foot inward.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ jiǎodǐ zhuǎn xiàng nèicè.
translation: 请把脚底转向内侧。

english: Please turn the sole of your foot outward.
transliteration: Qǐng bǎ jiǎodǐ zhuǎn xiàng wàicè.
translation: 请把脚底转向外侧。

english: Please wiggle your toes.
transliteration: Qǐng dòngdong jiǎozhǐ.
translation: 请动动脚趾。

english: Please stand on your tiptoes if you can.
transliteration: Rúguǒ kěyǐ, qǐng diǎn qǐ jiǎojiān zhànlì.
translation: 如果可以，请踮起脚尖站立。

english: Please try a single-leg heel raise if you feel safe.
transliteration: Rúguǒ nín juéde ānquán, qǐng shìzhe dān tuǐ diǎn jiǎogēn.
translation: 如果您觉得安全，请试着单腿踮脚跟。

english: I will gently move your ankle to check its stability.
transliteration: Wǒ huì qīngqīng huódòng yíxià nín de jiǎohuái, jiǎnchá tā shìfǒu wěngù.
translation: 我会轻轻活动一下您的脚踝，检查它是否稳固。

english: Does it hurt when I squeeze your lower leg here?
transliteration: Wǒ zài zhèlǐ ànyā nín xiǎotuǐ shí, huì tòng ma?
translation: 我在这里按压您小腿时，会痛吗？

english: Please show me exactly where your foot is tender.
transliteration: Qǐng zhǔnquè zhǐchū nín jiǎo shàng nǎlǐ yì pèng jiù tòng.
translation: 请准确指出您脚上哪里一碰就痛。

english: Can you feel me touching your skin here?
transliteration: Nín néng gǎnjué dào wǒ zài zhèlǐ pèng nín de pífū ma?
translation: 您能感觉到我在这里碰您的皮肤吗？

english: Does it feel the same on both sides?
transliteration: Liǎngbiān de gǎnjué yíyàng ma?
translation: 两边的感觉一样吗？

english: Please close your eyes while I check sensation.
transliteration: Wǒ jiǎnchá gǎnjué shí, qǐng nín bì shàng yǎnjing.
translation: 我检查感觉时，请您闭上眼睛。

english: Tell me whether this feels sharp or dull.
transliteration: Qǐng gàosu wǒ, zhè gǎnjué shì jiānruì háishi chídùn.
translation: 请告诉我，这感觉是尖锐还是迟钝。

english: Please push your foot down against my hand.
transliteration: Qǐng yòng jiǎo xiàng xià yā wǒ de shǒu.
translation: 请用脚向下压我的手。

english: Please pull your foot up against my hand.
transliteration: Qǐng yòng jiǎo xiàng shàng gōu wǒ de shǒu.
translation: 请用脚向上勾我的手。

english: Please straighten your knee against my hand.
transliteration: Qǐng yònglì bǎ xīgài shēn zhí, dǐ zhù wǒ de shǒu.
translation: 请用力把膝盖伸直，抵住我的手。

english: Please bend your knee against my hand.
transliteration: Qǐng yònglì wānqū xīgài, dǐ zhù wǒ de shǒu.
translation: 请用力弯曲膝盖，抵住我的手。

english: I am going to tap gently to check your reflexes.
transliteration: Wǒ huì qīngqīng qiāo yíxià, jiǎnchá nín de fǎnshè.
translation: 我会轻轻敲一下，检查您的反射。

english: I am checking the pulse in your hand or foot.
transliteration: Wǒ zhèngzài jiǎnchá nín shǒu huò jiǎo shàng de màibó.
translation: 我正在检查您手或脚上的脉搏。

english: I am checking the blood flow to your fingers or toes.
transliteration: Wǒ zhèngzài jiǎnchá xuèyè shìfǒu liú dào nín de shǒuzhǐ huò jiǎozhǐ.
translation: 我正在检查血液是否流到您的手指或脚趾。

english: Do your fingers or toes feel cold or numb?
transliteration: Nín de shǒuzhǐ huò jiǎozhǐ juéde lěng huò má ma?
translation: 您的手指或脚趾觉得冷或麻吗？

english: Please tell me immediately if you feel severe pain.
transliteration: Rúguǒ nín gǎndào jùliè téngtòng, qǐng mǎshàng gàosu wǒ.
translation: 如果您感到剧烈疼痛，请马上告诉我。

english: We may need an X-ray to check for a broken bone.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng xūyào pāi X guāng piàn, jiǎnchá yǒu méiyǒu gǔzhé.
translation: 我们可能需要拍X光片，检查有没有骨折。

english: We may need an ultrasound, CT scan, or MRI.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng xūyào zuò chāoshēngbō, CT sǎomiáo huò MRI jiǎnchá.
translation: 我们可能需要做超声波、CT扫描或MRI检查。

english: We may need to put your arm or leg in a splint.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng xūyào yòng jiábǎn gùdìng nín de shǒubì huò tuǐ.
translation: 我们可能需要用夹板固定您的手臂或腿。

english: We may need to put on a cast.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng xūyào gěi nín dǎ shígāo.
translation: 我们可能需要给您打石膏。

english: We may need to take fluid from the joint with a needle.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng xūyào yòng zhēn chōuqǔ guānjié lǐ de yètǐ.
translation: 我们可能需要用针抽取关节里的液体。

english: We may recommend physiotherapy.
transliteration: Wǒmen kěnéng huì jiànyì nín zuò wùlǐ zhìliáo.
translation: 我们可能会建议您做物理治疗。

english: We will arrange an appointment with an orthopedic specialist.
transliteration: Wǒmen huì wèi nín ānpái gǔkē zhuānkē yīshēng de yùyuē.
translation: 我们会为您安排骨科专科医生的预约。

english: You may have a sprain, which means a ligament has been stretched or torn.
transliteration: Nín kěnéng shì niǔshāng le, yě jiùshì rèndài bèi lāshāng huò sīliè le.
translation: 您可能是扭伤了，也就是韧带被拉伤或撕裂了。

english: A fracture means a bone is broken or cracked.
transliteration: Gǔzhé shì zhǐ gǔtou duàn le huò liè le.
translation: 骨折是指骨头断了或裂了。

english: You may have inflammation of a tendon.
transliteration: Nín de jījiàn kěnéng fāyán le.
translation: 您的肌腱可能发炎了。

english: Please follow the weight-bearing instructions given to you.
transliteration: Qǐng ànzhào gěi nín de fùzhòng zhǐshì jìnxíng huódòng.
translation: 请按照给您的负重指示进行活动。

english: Use your crutches or walking aid as instructed.
transliteration: Qǐng ànzhào zhǐdǎo shǐyòng guǎizhàng huò zhùxíngqì.
translation: 请按照指导使用拐杖或助行器。

english: Keep your cast or splint dry unless told otherwise.
transliteration: Chúfēi yīhù rényuán lìng yǒu jiāodài, qǐng bǎochí shígāo huò jiábǎn gānzào.
translation: 除非医护人员另有交代，请保持石膏或夹板干燥。
